items.e: Narrated by Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Harun ibn Muslim from al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Zurarah from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them: Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is on nine things: on gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, and sheep; And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, exempted everything other than these.”
items.o: مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلزَّكَاةُ فِي تِسْعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ عَلَى اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ وَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ وَ عَفَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ«.
items.h: Chapter on That in Which Zakat Is Obligatory

items.e: From him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the charities of wealth’. Imam (a.s) said: “They are in nine things and there is nothing in anything other than them. They are gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, and grazing sheep, and these (animal) are those that pasture. There is nothing in any animal other than these three categories. And every thing that is from these three categories has nothing due on it until a full year passes over it from the day it is born.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَدَقَاتِ اَلْأَمْوَالِ فَقَالَ» فِي تِسْعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ لَيْسَ فِي غَيْرِهَا شَيْءٌ فِي اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ وَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ اَلسَّائِمَةِ وَ هِيَ اَلرَّاعِيَةُ وَ لَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلْحَيَوَانِ غَيْرِ هَذِهِ اَلثَّلاَثَةِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ شَيْءٌ وَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ كَانَ مِنْ هَذِهِ اَلثَّلاَثَةِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ مُنْذُ يَوْمِ يُنْتَجُ«.

items.e: And from him, from al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Basir and al-Hasan ibn Shihab, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: "The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, placed zakat upon nine things and pardoned what is besides that. It is upon gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, and sheep.
items.o: وعنه عن العباس بن عامر عن ابان بن عثمان عن ابي بصير والحسن ابن شهاب عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: وضع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله الزكاة على تسعة اشياء، وعفا عما سوى ذلك، على الذهب والفضة والحنطة والشعير والتمر والزبيب والابل والبقر والغنم.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘zakat’. Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is upon nine things: upon gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, and sheep; And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, pardoned what is besides that.
items.o: وعنه عن محمد بن عبد الله بن زرارة عن محمد بن أبي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان عن عبيد الله بن علي الحلبي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: سئل عن الزكاة قال: الزكاة على تسعة اشياء: على الذهب والفضة والحنطة والشعير والتمر والزبيب والابل والبقر والغنم، وعفا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله عما سوى ذلك

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Abu Basir and Burayd ibn Muawiyah al-Ijli and al-Fudayl ibn Yasar from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “Allah (swt) made zakat obligatory along with prayer in wealth, and the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, established it in nine things and pardoned whatever is besides them. The Zakat is in gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, and sheep; And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pardoned whatever is besides that.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» فَرَضَ اَللَّهُ اَلزَّكَاةَ مَعَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلْأَمْوَالِ وَسَنَّهَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي تِسْعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ وَ عَفَا عَمَّا سِوَاهُنَّ فِي اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ وَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ وَ عَفَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, placed zakat upon nine things. It is upon wheat, barley, dates, raisins, gold, silver, camels, cattle, and sheep; and the Prophet (saws) pardoned what is besides that.
items.o: وعنه عن علي عن أبيه عن إسماعيل بن مرار عن يونس عن عبد الله بن مسكان عن ابي بكر الحضرمي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: وضع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله الزكاة على تسعة اشياء: على الحنطة والشعير والتمر والزبيب والذهب والفضة والابل والبقر والغنم، وعفا عما سوى ذلك.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I asked Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, ‘about crops; what is zakat to be given from them?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Wheat, barley, maize, millet, rice, barley without husk (al-sult), lentils, and sesame; all of that is to have zakat given from it, and what resembles it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْحَرْثِ مَا يُزَكَّى مِنْهُ فَقَالَ» اَلْبُرُّ وَاَلشَّعِيرُ وَاَلذُّرَةُ وَاَلدُّخْنُ وَاَلْأَرُزُّ وَاَلسُّلْتُ وَاَلْعَدَسُ وَاَلسِّمْسِمُ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يُزَكَّى وَأَشْبَاهُهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Samaah, from the one whom he mentioned, from Aban, from Abu Maryam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘crops, from what zakat is to be given.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Wheat, barley, maize, rice, barley without husk (al-sult), and lentils; all of this is from that which zakat is to be given.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Everything that is measured by the sa’ and reaches the awsaq, then zakat is due on it.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْحَرْثِ مِمَّا يُزَكَّى فَقَالَ» اَلْبُرُّ وَ اَلشَّعِيرُ وَ اَلذُّرَةُ وَ اَلْأَرُزُّ وَاَلسُّلْتُ وَاَلْعَدَسُ كُلُّ هَذَا مِمَّا يُزَكَّى« وَ قَالَ »كُلُّمَا كِيلَ بِالصَّاعِ فَبَلَغَ اَلْأَوْسَاقَ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ«.

items.e: What was narrated by Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi and al-Abbas ibn Amir, all together, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn al-Tayyar, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘that in which zakat becomes obligatory.’ Imam (a.s) said: “(Zakat is) in nine things: gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, and sheep; And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pardoned whatever is besides that.” So I (narrator) asked: “May Allah (swt) set you right, we have a great deal of grain.” So Imam (a.s) said: “And what is it?” I replied: “Rice.” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, how abundant it is.” So I asked: “Is there zakat in it?” Muhammad ibn al-Tayyar narrates that then Imam (a.s) rebuked me. Then Imam (a.s) said: “I say to you that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pardoned whatever is besides that, and you (still) say to me: ‘We have a great deal of grain; is there zakat in it?’”
items.o: مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ وَ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلطَّيَّارِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَمَّا يَجِبُ فِيهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ فَقَالَ» فِي تِسْعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ وَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ وَ عَفَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ« فَقُلْتُ أَصْلَحَكَ اَللَّهُ فَإِنَّ عِنْدَنَا حَبّاً كَثِيراً قَالَ فَقَالَ» وَ مَا هُوَ« قُلْتُ اَلْأَرُزُّ قَالَ» نَعَمْ مَا أَكْثَرَهُ« فَقُلْتُ أَ فِيهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ قَالَ فَزَبَرَنِي قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ» أَقُولُ لَكَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَفَا عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ وَ تَقُولُ لِي إِنَّ عِنْدَنَا حَبّاً كَثِيراً أَ فِيهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said: I heard Imam (a.s) saying: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, placed zakat on nine things and pardoned whatever is besides that: on silver, gold, wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, and sheep.” So (Muhammad ibn) al-Tayyar said to Imam (a.s), while I was present: “We have a great deal of grain which is called rice.” So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to him (al-Tayyar): “And we have a great deal of grain.” He (al-Tayyar) asked: “Then is there anything due on it?” – meaning zakat Imam (a.s) said: “No. I have already informed you that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pardoned whatever is besides that.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ اَلزَّكَاةَ عَلَى تِسْعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ وَ عَفَا عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ عَلَى اَلْفِضَّةِ وَ اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ« فَقَالَ لَهُ اَلطَّيَّارُ وَ أَنَا حَاضِرٌ إِنَّ عِنْدَنَا حَبّاً كَثِيراً يُقَالُ لَهُ اَلْأَرُزُّ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» وَ عِنْدَنَا حَبٌّ كَثِيرٌ« قَالَ فَعَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ قَالَ» لاَ قَدْ أَعْلَمْتُكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَفَا عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Abbas ibn Maruf from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said: I (the narrator) read in the letter of Abdullah ibn Muhammad to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be made your ransom, it has been narrated from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said: ‘The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, placed zakat on nine things: on wheat, barley, dates, raisins, gold, silver, sheep, cattle, and camels; And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pardoned whatever is besides that.’ So the speaker had said to Imam (a.s): “We have something abundant, many times more than that.” Imam (a.s) said to him: “What is it?” So he said to Imam (a.s): “Rice.” So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to him: “I say to you that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, placed charity on nine things and pardoned whatever is besides that, and you (still) say: ‘We have rice and we have maize’. Maize already existed during the time of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.” Imam Musa al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in reply: “It is like that, and zakat is in everything that is measured by the sa’.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ فِي كِتَابِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ ع جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ» وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ اَلزَّكَاةَ عَلَى تِسْعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ عَلَى اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ عَفَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ص عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ« فَقَالَ لَهُ اَلْقَائِلُ عِنْدَنَا شَيْءٌ كَثِيرٌ يَكُونُ بِأَضْعَافِ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ» مَا هُوَ« فَقَالَ لَهُ اَلْأَرُزُّ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» أَقُولُ لَكَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَضَعَ اَلصَّدَقَةَ عَلَى تِسْعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ وَ عَفَا عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ وَ تَقُولُ إِنَّ عِنْدَنَا أَرُزّاً وَ عِنْدَنَا ذُرَةً قَدْ كَانَتِ اَلذُّرَةُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ ص« فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» كَذَلِكَ هُوَ وَ اَلزَّكَاةُ فِي كُلِّ مَا كِيلَ بِالصَّاعِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan said: Muhammad ibn Ismail narrated to me from Hammad ibn Isa from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah and Bukayr, the two sons of Ayan, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no Zakat due on anything produced by the earth, such as rice, maize, chickpeas, lentils, and the rest of the grains and fruits, apart from the four categories. Even if its sale value is great, nothing is due on it unless it becomes wealth that is sold for gold or silver, and that gold or silver is stored until a full year passes over it. Once it has become gold or silver, Zakat is paid from it. It will be five dirhams from every two hundred dirhams, and half a dinar from every twenty dinars.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ بُكَيْرٍ اِبْنَيْ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي شَيْ ءٍأَنْبَتَتِ اَلْأَرْضُ مِنَ اَلْأَرُزِّ وَ اَلذُّرَةِ وَاَلْحِمَّصِ وَاَلْعَدَسِ وَ سَائِرِ اَلْحُبُوبِ وَاَلْفَوَاكِهِ غَيْرِ هَذِهِ اَلْأَرْبَعَةِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ وَ إِنْ كَثُرَ ثَمَنُهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَصِيرَ مَا لاً يُبَاعُ بِذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ يَكْنِزُهُ ثُمَّ يَحُولُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَ قَدْ صَارَ ذَهَباً أَوْ فِضَّةً فَيُؤَدِّي عَنْهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ خَمْسَةَ دَرَاهِمَ وَ مِنْ كُلِّ عِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً نِصْفَ دِينَارٍ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from a number of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ibn Faddal from Ali ibn Uqbah and a number of our companions from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing due on less than twenty mithqals of gold. Then when it completes twenty mithqals, there is half a mithqal due on it, up to twenty-four (mithqals of gold). Then when it completes twenty-four (mithqals of gold), there are three-fifths of a dinar due on it, up to twenty-eight (mithqals of gold). So upon this calculation, whenever four increase.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْعِشْرِينَ مِثْقَالاً مِنَ اَلذَّهَبِ شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا كَمَلَتْ عِشْرِينَ مِثْقَالاً فَفِيهَا نِصْفُ مِثْقَالٍ إِلَى أَرْبَعَةٍ وَعِشْرِينَ فَإِذَا كَمَلَتْ أَرْبَعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ فَفِيهَا ثَلاَثَةُ أَخْمَاسِ دِينَارٍ إِلَى ثَمَانِيَةٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ فَعَلَى هَذَا اَلْحِسَابِ كُلَّمَا زَادَ أَرْبَعَةٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Sindi ibn Muhammad from Aban ibn Uthman from Yahya ibn Abi al-Ala from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “In twenty dinars there is half a dinar.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ سِنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي عِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “In gold, when it reaches twenty dinars, there is half a dinar due on it, and there is nothing due on what is less than twenty. And in silver, when it reaches two hundred dirhams, there are five dirhams due, and there is nothing due on what is less than two hundred. Then if thirty-nine are added to the two hundred, there is nothing due on it until it reaches forty. And there is nothing due on any fractions until it reaches forty. And likewise the dinars are according to this calculation.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي اَلذَّهَبِ إِذَا بَلَغَ عِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً فَفِيهِ نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْعِشْرِينَ شَيْءٌ وَ فِي اَلْفِضَّةِ إِذَا بَلَغَتْ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ خَمْسَةُ دَرَاهِمَ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْمِائَتَيْنِ شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ تِسْعَةٌ وَ ثَلاَثُونَ عَلَى اَلْمِائَتَيْنِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ وَ لَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلْكُسُورِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلدَّنَانِيرُ عَلَى هَذَا اَلْحِسَابِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil from some of our companions, that he said: He said: “There is no zakat on uncoined gold or silver (al-tibr); it is only on dinars and dirhams.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي اَلتِّبْرِ زَكَاةٌ إِنَّمَا هِيَ عَلَى اَلدَّنَانِيرِ وَ اَلدَّرَاهِمِ«.

items.e: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘wealth that is not worked with and not turned over.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is binding on it every year, unless it is melted down.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَالِ اَلَّذِي لاَ يُعْمَلُ بِهِ وَ لاَ يُقَلَّبُ قَالَ» يَلْزَمُهُ اَلزَّكَاةُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُسْبَكَ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (a.s) and Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon them both: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no Zakat due on raw/unminted gold or silver; it is only upon dinars and dirhams.”
items.o: علي بن الحسن بن علي بن فضال عن جعفر بن محمد بن حكيم عن جميل بن دراج عن ابي عبد الله وابى الحسن عليهما السلام انه قال: ليس على التبر زكاة انما هي على الدنانير والدراهم.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Ubaydi from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Ali ibn Yaqtin from Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I said to Imam (a.s): “A large thing of value gathers with me, then it remains for about a year; should we give zakat on it?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. Everything over which a full year has not passed while it is with you, there is no zakat upon you in it. And everything that is not ‘engraved’ money (rikaz), there is nothing upon you in it.” He (the narrator) said, “I asked: ‘And what is ‘engraved’ money (rikaz)?’” Imam (a.s) said: “The stamped, non-speaking currency.” - meaning minted gold and silver coinage. Then Imam (a.s) said: “When you want that, then smelt it down, for there is no zakat on ingots of gold and pieces of silver.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى اَلْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّهُ يَجْتَمِعُ عِنْدِيَ اَلشَّيْءُ اَلْكَثِيرُ قِيمَتُهُ فَيَبْقَى نَحْواً مِنْ سَنَةٍ أَ نُزَكِّيهِ فَقَالَ »لاَ كُلُّ مَا لَمْ يَحُلْ عِنْدَكَ عَلَيْهِ حَوْلٌ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ وَ كُلُّ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ رِكَازاً فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ« قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ مَا اَلرِّكَازُ قَالَ» اَلصَّامِتُ اَلْمَنْقُوشُ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» إِذَا أَرَدْتَ ذَلِكَ فَاسْبِكْهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي سَبَائِكِ اَلذَّهَبِ وَنِقَارِ اَلْفِضَّةِ زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Rifaah, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when some of them (companions) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘jewellery, Is there zakat in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, even if it reaches one hundred thousand (dirhams).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ سَأَلَهُ بَعْضُهُمْ عَنِ اَلْحُلِيِّ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ وَ إِنْ بَلَغَ مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about ‘jewellery, Is there zakat in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْحُلِيِّ أَ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ قَالَ» لاَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The zakat of jewellery is that it be lent.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» زَكَاةُ اَلْحُلِيِّ أَنْ يُعَارَ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Ahmad and Muhammad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Yaqub al-Hashimi from Marwan ibn Muslim from Abu al-Hasan, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘jewellery, Is there zakat in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat in it, even if it reaches one hundred thousand dirhams, and my Father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) opposes the people in this.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْحُلِيِّ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ قَالَ» إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ وَإِنْ بَلَغَ مِائَةَ أَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ وَ أَبِي يُخَالِفُ اَلنَّاسَ فِي هَذَا«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘jewellery, Is there zakat in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, except that by which one has fled from zakat.” – meaning intentionally subverted to avoid zakat.
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْحُلِيِّ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ قَالَ» لاَ إِلاَّ مَا فُرَّ بِهِ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I said to Imam (a.s): “A man makes jewellery for his family from one hundred dinars, two hundred dinars, and I think I said three hundred dinars; is zakat due on it?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat in it.” He (the narrator) said: “I asked: ‘But he fled through it from zakat.’” Imam (a.s) said: “If he fled through it from zakat, then zakat is due on him; And if he only did it in order to adorn himself with it, then there is no zakat upon him.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَجْعَلُ لِأَهْلِهِ اَلْحُلِيَّ مِنْ مِائَةِ دِينَارٍ وَ اَلْمِائَتَيْ دِينَارٍ وَأَرَانِي قَدْ قُلْتُ ثَلاَثِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ قَالَ» لَيْسَ فِيهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ فَرَّ بِهِ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ بِهِ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ إِنَّمَا فَعَلَهُ لِيَتَجَمَّلَ بِهِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: And that which Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Harun ibn Kharijah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I said to Imam (a.s): “My brother Yusuf was appointed over works for these people, and he acquired much wealth through them, and he made that wealth into jewellery, intending to flee through it from zakat; is zakat due on him?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat on jewellery, and the loss he has brought upon himself by making it (jewellery) and by depriving himself of its surplus is greater than what he fears from zakat.”
items.o: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ أَخِي يُوسُفَ وُلِّيَ لِهَؤُلاَءِ أَعْمَالاً أَصَابَ فِيهَا أَمْوَالاً كَثِيرَةً وَ إِنَّهُ جَعَلَ ذَلِكَ اَلْمَالَ حُلِيّاً أَرَادَ أَنْ يَفِرَّ بِهِ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ أَ عَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْحُلِيِّ زَكَاةٌ وَمَا أَدْخَلَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ مِنَ اَلنُّقْصَانِ فِي وَضْعِهِ وَ مَنْعِهِ نَفْسَهُ فَضْلَهُ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Your father (Imam al Baqir (a.s)) said: ‘Whoever flees through it from zakat, then he must pay it.’” Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s) spoke the truth. He must pay (zakat) on what became obligatory upon him, and as for what did not become obligatory upon him, then there is nothing upon him from it.” Then Imam (a.s) said to me: “Tell me, if a man were to lose consciousness for a day and then die, so his prayer passed away, would it be upon him, after he had died, to perform it?” I (the narrator) replied: “No.” Imam (a.s) said: “Except if he had regained consciousness during his day.” Then Imam (a.s) said to me (the narrator): “Tell me, if a man became ill in the month of Ramadan and then died in it, would fasting be performed on his behalf?” I (the narrator) replied: “No.” Imam (a.s) said: “And likewise, a man does not pay (zakat) from his wealth except what has fallen due upon it.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ أَبَاكَ قَالَ» مَنْ فَرَّ بِهَا مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَهَا« قَالَ» صَدَقَ أَبِي إِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَ مَا وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ وَ مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ عَلَيْهِ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ« ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي» أَ رَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً ثُمَّ مَاتَ فَذَهَبَتْ صَلاَتُهُ أَ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَدْ مَاتَ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَهَا« قُلْتُ لاَ قَالَ» إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَفَاقَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي» أَ رَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مَرِضَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فِيهِ أَ كَانَ يُصَامُ عَنْهُ« قُلْتُ لاَ قَالَ» وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلرَّجُلُ لاَ يُؤَدِّي عَنْ مَالِهِ إِلاَّ مَا حَلَّ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘gold, how much zakat is due on it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “When its value reaches two hundred dirhams, then zakat is due on it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلذَّهَبِ كَمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَقَالَ» إِذَا بَلَغَ قِيمَتُهُ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Abu Basir and Burayd and al-Fudayl ibn Yasar from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “In gold, in every forty mithqals there is one mithqal, and in silver coin (al-wariq), in every two hundred dirhams there are five dirhams. There is nothing due on less than forty mithqals, and nothing due on less than two hundred dirhams. And there is nothing due on the excess (al-nayyif) until forty is completed (mithqal), then there is one due in it.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ بُرَيْدٍ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» فِي اَلذَّهَبِ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ مِثْقَالاً مِثْقَالٌ وَ فِي اَلْوَرِقِ فِي كُلِّ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ خَمْسَةُ دَرَاهِمَ وَ لَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ مِثْقَالاً شَيْءٌ وَ لاَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِي اَلنَّيِّفِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَتِمَّ أَرْبَعُونَ فَيَكُونَ فِيهِ وَاحِدٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated from Harun ibn Muslim from al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Zurarah from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat on silver until it reaches two hundred dirhams. Then when it reaches two hundred dirhams, there are five dirhams due on it. If it increases beyond that, then according to that calculation: in every forty dirhams, one dirham. There is nothing due on the fractions. And there is no zakat on gold until it reaches twenty mithqals. Then when it reaches twenty mithqals, there is half a mithqal due on it. Then according to that calculation, when the wealth increases: in every forty dinars, one dinar.”
items.o: رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي اَلْفِضَّةِ زَكَاةٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَفِيهَا خَمْسَةُ دَرَاهِمَ فَإِنْ زَادَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَعَلَى حِسَابِ ذَلِكَ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَماً دِرْهَمٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِي اَلْكُسُورِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِي اَلذَّهَبِ زَكَاةٌ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ عِشْرِينَ مِثْقَالاً فَإِذَا بَلَغَ عِشْرِينَ مِثْقَالاً فَفِيهِ نِصْفُ مِثْقَالٍ ثُمَّ عَلَى حِسَابِ ذَلِكَ إِذَا زَادَ اَلْمَالُ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ دِينَاراً دِينَارٌ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Samaah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “In every two hundred dirhams, there are five dirhams from silver; and if it is less, then there is no zakat upon you. And from gold, from every twenty dinars there is half a dinar; and if it is less, then there is nothing upon you.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي كُلِّ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ خَمْسَةُ دَرَاهِمَ مِنَ اَلْفِضَّةِ وَ إِنْ نَقَصَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ زَكَاةٌ وَ مِنَ اَلذَّهَبِ مِنْ كُلِّ عِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ وَ إِنْ نَقَصَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Sindi ibn Muhammad from Aban ibn Uthman al-Ahmar from Muhammad al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “When forty dirhams are added to the two hundred dirhams, then there is one dirham due on them, and there is nothing due on anything less than forty.” So I (narrator) asked: “Then what is due on thirty-nine dirhams?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing due on the thirty-nine dirhams.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ سِنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ اَلْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا زَادَ عَلَى اَلْمِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ أَرْبَعُونَ دِرْهَماً فَفِيهَا دِرْهَمٌ وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ شَيْءٌ« فَقُلْتُ فَمَا فِي تِسْعَةٍ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ دِرْهَماً قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلتِّسْعَةِ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ دِرْهَماً شَيْءٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Muhammad ibn Ismail from Hammad ibn Isa from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah and Bukayr, the two sons of Ayan, that they both heard: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “As for Zakat on gold, there is nothing due on anything less than twenty dinars. When it reaches twenty dinars, half a dinar is due on it. And there is nothing due on anything less than two hundred dirhams. When it reaches two hundred dirhams, five dirhams are due on it. Whatever exceeds that is calculated accordingly. On two hundred dirhams up to one dirham less than two hundred and forty dirhams, nothing more than five dirhams is due. Then when it reaches two hundred and forty dirhams, six dirhams are due. When it reaches two hundred and eighty dirhams, seven dirhams are due. Whatever exceeds that is calculated according to this same calculation. The same applies to gold. Zakat is only due on stored gold and silver once a full year has passed over it. As for anything over which a full year has not passed, there is nothing due on it.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ بُكَيْرٍ اِبْنَيْ أَعْيَنَ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» فِي اَلزَّكَاةِ أَمَّا فِي اَلذَّهَبِ فَلَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ عِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا بَلَغَ عِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً فَفِيهِ نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ وَ لَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَفِيهَا خَمْسَةُ دَرَاهِمَ فَمَا زَادَ فَبِحِسَابِ ذَلِكَ وَ لَيْسَ فِي مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ وَ أَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَماً غَيْرِ دِرْهَمٍ إِلاَّ خَمْسَةُ دَرَاهِمَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ أَرْبَعِينَ وَمِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَفِيهَا سِتَّةُ دَرَاهِمَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ ثَمَانِينَ وَمِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَفِيهَا سَبْعَةُ دَرَاهِمَ وَمَا زَادَ فَعَلَى هَذَا اَلْحِسَابِ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلذَّهَبُ وَ كُلُّ ذَهَبٍ وَ إِنَّمَا اَلزَّكَاةُ عَلَى اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ اَلْمَوْضُوعِ إِذَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ فَفِيهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَ مَا لَمْ يَحُلْ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father and al-Husayn ibn Said from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Whatever the earth produces of wheat, barley, dates, and raisins, when it reaches five awsaq, and the wasq is sixty sa’, then that is three hundred sa’, then in it is the tenth (10%). And whatever of it is watered by ropes (al-risha), waterwheels (al-dawali), and water-carrying camels (al-nawadih), then in it is half of the tenth (5%). And whatever the sky waters, or flowing water (al-sayh), or it is rain-fed land (bal), then in it is the complete tenth (10%). And there is nothing due on what is less than three hundred sa’. And there is nothing due in what the earth produces except in these four things.”
items.o: يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَا أَنْبَتَتِ اَلْأَرْضُ مِنَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَاَلزَّبِيبِ مَا بَلَغَ خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً فَذَلِكَ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ صَاعٍ فَفِيهِ اَلْعُشْرُ وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهُ يُسْقَى بِالرِّشَاءِ وَاَلدَّوَالِي وَاَلنَّوَاضِحِ فَفِيهِ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ وَ مَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ أَوِ اَلسَّيْحُ أَوْ كَانَ بَعْلاً فَفِيهِ اَلْعُشْرُ تَامّاً وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلثَّلاَثِمِائَةِ صَاعٍ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا أَنْبَتَتِ اَلْأَرْضُ شَيْءٌ إِلاَّ فِي هَذِهِ اَلْأَرْبَعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ«.
items.h: Chapter on Zakat of Wheat, Barley, Dates, and Raisins

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from his two brothers from their father from Ali ibn Uqbah from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from some of our companions from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the zakat of wheat, barley, dates, and raisins, there is no zakat on what is less than five awsaq. Then when it reaches five awsaq, zakat becomes obligatory in it. The wasq is sixty sa’, so that is three hundred sa’ according to the sa’ of the Holy Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. The zakat in it is the tenth (10%) in what the sky waters or what is flowing water, Or half of the tenth (5%) in what is watered by the bucket (al-gharb) and the water-carrying camels (al-nawadih).”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَخَوَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي زَكَاةِ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْخَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ زَكَاةٌ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ وَجَبَتْ فِيهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً فَذَلِكَ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ صَاعٍ بِصَاعِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ اَلزَّكَاةُ فِيهَا اَلْعُشْرُ فِيمَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ أَوْ كَانَ سَيْحاً أَوْ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ فِيمَا سُقِيَ بِالْغَرْبِ وَاَلنَّوَاضِحِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah ibn Zurarah from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam (a.s): “In how much does zakat become obligatory from wheat, barley, dates, and raisins?” Imam (a.s) said: “In sixty sa’.” And Imam (a.s) said in another hadith: “There is no charity on date palms until it reaches five awsaq, And grapes are like that until they reach five awsaq as raisins, And the wasq is sixty sa’.” The Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the charity of what is watered by the bucket (al-gharb), there is half the charity; And what the sky and rivers water, or what is rain-fed land (bal), then the charity is due, and it is the tenth; And what is watered by waterwheels (al-dawali) or by the bucket (al-gharb), then half of the tenth.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ فِي كَمْ تَجِبُ اَلزَّكَاةُ مِنَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ قَالَ» فِي سِتِّينَ صَاعاً« وَ قَالَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ» لَيْسَ فِي اَلنَّخْلِ صَدَقَةٌ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ وَ اَلْعِنَبُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ زَبِيباً وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً« وَ قَالَ» فِي صَدَقَةِ مَا سُقِيَ بِالْغَرْبِ نِصْفُ اَلصَّدَقَةِ وَ مَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ وَ اَلْأَنْهَارُ أَوْ كَانَ بَعْلاً فَالصَّدَقَةُ وَ هُوَ اَلْعُشْرُ وَ مَا سُقِيَ بِالدَّوَالِي أَوْ بِالْغَرْبِ فَنِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ«.

items.e: As for the report which Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Said from his brother al-Hasan ibn Said from Zurah ibn Muhammad al-Hadrami from Samaah ibn Mihran, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘zakat on dates and raisins.’ Imam (a.s) said: “In every five awsaq there is one wasq, and the wasq is sixty sa’, and zakat in both of them is the same.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا اَلْخَبَرُ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ فِي اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ فَقَالَ» فِي كُلِّ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ وَسْقٌ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً وَ اَلزَّكَاةُ فِيهِمَا سَوَاءٌ«.

items.e: And that which Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Abu Ali al-Ashari from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Samaah, who said: I asked him about ‘zakat on raisins and dates.’ So he said: “In every five awsaq there is one wasq, and the wasq is sixty sa’, and zakat in both of them is the same. As for food, then the tenth is due on what the sky waters; And as for what is watered by the bucket (al-gharb) and the waterwheels (al-dawali), then only half of the tenth is due on it.”
items.o: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ فِي اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ فَقَالَ» فِي كُلِّ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ وَسْقٌ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً وَ اَلزَّكَاةُ فِيهِمَا سَوَاءٌ فَأَمَّا اَلطَّعَامُ فَالْعُشُرُ فِيمَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ وَ أَمَّا مَا سُقِيَ بِالْغَرْبِ وَاَلدَّوَالِي فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Shuja al-Naysaburi narrated to me: He (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who obtained from his estate one hundred kurrs of wheat, from which zakat is to be given, so the tenth was taken from it, ten kurrs, and thirty kurrs of it went because of the maintenance of the estate, and sixty kurrs remained in his hand. What is it that is obligatory for you (khums) from that, and is anything from that obligatory upon him for his companions?’ Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in reply: “For me from it is the khums from whatever remains beyond his expenses.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ شُجَاعٍ اَلنَّيْسَابُورِيُّ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَ مِنْ ضَيْعَتِهِ مِنَ اَلْحِنْطَةِ مِائَةَ كُرٍّ مَا يُزَكَّى فَأُخِذَ مِنْهُ اَلْعُشْرُ عَشَرَةُ أَكْرَارٍ وَ ذَهَبَ مِنْهُ بِسَبَبِ عِمَارَةِ اَلضَّيْعَةِ ثَلاَثُونَ كُرّاً وَ بَقِيَ فِي يَدِهِ سِتُّونَ كُرّاً مَا اَلَّذِي يَجِبُ لَكَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَ هَلْ يَجِبُ لِأَصْحَابِهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لِي مِنْهُ اَلْخُمُسُ مِمَّا يَفْضُلُ مِنْ مَئُونَتِهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas ibn Maruf from Hammad from Hariz from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah and Bukayr from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding zakat, whatever is managed by ropes (al-risha), buckets (al-dila), and water-carrying camels (al-nawadih), then in it is half of the tenth (5%). And if it is watered without treatment, by a river, spring, rain-fed land (bal), or sky, then in it is the full tenth (10%).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي اَلزَّكَاةِ مَا كَانَ يُعَالَجُ بِالرِّشَاءِ وَاَلدِّلاَءِ وَاَلنَّوَاضِحِ فَفِيهِ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يُسْقَى مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلاَجٍ بِنَهْرٍ أَوْ عَيْنٍ أَوْ بَعْلٍ أَوْ سَمَاءٍ فَفِيهِ اَلْعُشْرُ كَامِلاً«.

items.e: And from him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiyah ibn Shurayh, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “In whatever the sky and rivers water, or what is rain-fed land (bal), then there is the tenth (10%). As for what the water-drawing camels (al-sawani) and waterwheels (al-dawali) water, then there is half of the tenth (5%).” So I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “The land we have is watered by waterwheels, then the water increases and it is watered by flowing water (sayh).” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, that happens among you like that?” I replied: “Yes.” Imam (a.s) said: “Half and half: half with half of the tenth, and half with the tenth.” So I (narrator) asked: “And the land is watered by waterwheels, then the water increases, and it is watered once or twice by flowing water.” Imam (a.s) said: “And how much is it watered once or twice by flowing water?” I (narrator) replied: “In thirty nights, forty nights, while before that it had remained in the land for six months, seven months.” Imam (a.s) said: “Half of the tenth.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِيمَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ وَ اَلْأَنْهَارُ أَوْ كَانَ بَعْلاً فَالْعُشُرُ فَأَمَّا مَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّوَانِي وَاَلدَّوَالِي فَنِصْفُ اَلْعُشُرِ« فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَالْأَرْضُ تَكُونُ عِنْدَنَا تُسْقَى بِالدَّوَالِي ثُمَّ يَزِيدُ اَلْمَاءُ وَ تُسْقَى سَيْحاً فَقَالَ» إِنَّ ذَا لَيَكُونُ عِنْدَكُمْ كَذَلِكَ« قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ »اَلنِّصْفُ وَ اَلنِّصْفُ نِصْفٌ بِنِصْفِ اَلْعُشُرِ وَ نِصْفٌ بِالْعُشُرِ« فَقُلْتُ وَ اَلْأَرْضُ تُسْقَى بِالدَّوَالِي ثُمَّ يَزِيدُ اَلْمَاءُ فَتُسْقَى اَلسَّقْيَةَ وَاَلسَّقْيَتَيْنِ سَيْحاً قَالَ» وَ كَمْ تُسْقَى اَلسَّقْيَةَ وَاَلسَّقْيَتَيْنِ سَيْحاً« قُلْتُ فِي ثَلاَثِينَ لَيْلَةً أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً وَ قَدْ مَكَثَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فِي اَلْأَرْضِ سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ سَبْعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ قَالَ» نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn al-Sindi from Safwan ibn Yahya from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘wheat and dates, and the zakat upon them.’ Imam (a.s) said: “The tenth (10%) and half of the tenth (5%): the tenth in what the sky waters, and half of the tenth from what is watered by water-drawing camels (al-sawani).” So I (narrator) asked: “I am not asking you about this; rather, I am asking you about what comes out of it, whether little or much. Does it have a limit from which zakat is to be given from what comes out of it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is to be given from what comes out of it, whether little or much: from every ten, one, and from every ten, half of one.” I (the narrator) asked: “Then wheat and dates are the same?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَاَلتَّمْرِ عَنْ زَكَاتِهِمَا فَقَالَ» اَلْعُشْرُ وَ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ اَلْعُشُرُ فِيمَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ وَنِصْفُ اَلْعُشُرِ مِمَّا سُقِيَ بِالسَّوَانِي« فَقُلْتُ لَيْسَ عَنْ هَذَا أَسْأَلُكَ إِنَّمَا أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَّا خَرَجَ مِنْهُ قَلِيلاً كَانَ أَوْ كَثِيراً أَ لَهُ حَدٌّ يُزَكَّى مِمَّا خَرَجَ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ» يُزَكَّى مِمَّا خَرَجَ مِنْهُ قَلِيلاً كَانَ أَوْ كَثِيراً مِنْ كُلِّ عَشَرَةٍ وَاحِدٌ وَ مِنْ كُلِّ عَشَرَةٍ نِصْفُ وَاحِدٍ« قُلْتُ فَالْحِنْطَةُ وَ اَلتَّمْرُ سَوَاءٌ قَالَ» نَعَمْ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn al-Sindi from Hammad ibn Isa from Shuayb ibn Yaqub from Abu Basir, who said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Charity does not become obligatory except in two wasqs, and the wasq is sixty sa’.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» لاَ تَجِبُ اَلصَّدَقَةُ إِلاَّ فِي وَسْقَيْنِ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً«.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat in grain, nor in date palms, nor in grapes, until they reach two wasqs; and the wasq is sixty sa’.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ يَكُونُ فِي اَلْحَبِّ وَ لاَ فِي اَلنَّخْلِ وَ لاَ فِي اَلْعِنَبِ زَكَاةٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ وَسْقَيْنِ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from some of our companions, from Ibn Sinan, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘zakat, In how much does it become obligatory in wheat and barley?’ Imam (a.s) said: “In one wasq.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ فِي كَمْ تَجِبُ فِي اَلْحِنْطَةِ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ فَقَالَ» فِي وَسْقٍ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Husayn from al-Nadr from Hisham from Sulayman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no charity on date palms until they reach five awsaq, and grapes are like that until they become five awsaq as raisins.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي اَلنَّخْلِ صَدَقَةٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ وَ اَلْعِنَبُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ زَبِيباً«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘dates and raisins, what is the least amount in which zakat becomes obligatory?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Five awsaq. And Muafarah (inferior date variety) and Umm Jurur (low-quality date variety) are left, and zakat is not given on them, even if they are abundant. And one cluster or two clusters are left for the guard, and the guard is the one who is in the date palms watching over them, so that is left for his dependents.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع عَنِ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ مَا أَقَلُّ مَا تَجِبُ فِيهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ فَقَالَ» خَمْسَةُ أَوْسَاقٍ وَ يُتْرَكُ مِعَافَأْرَةٍ وَ أُمُّ جُعْرُورٍ وَ لاَ يُزَكَّيَانِ وَ إِنْ كَثُرَا وَ يُتْرَكُ لِلْحَارِسِ اَلْعَذْقُ وَاَلْعَذْقَانِ وَاَلْحَارِسُ يَكُونُ فِي اَلنَّخْلِ يَنْظُرُهُ فَيُتْرَكُ ذَلِكَ لِعِيَالِهِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad from Abu Jafar from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing due on what is less than five awsaq, and the wasq is sixty sa’.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِاَللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ شَيْءٌ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan from al-Qasim ibn Amir from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu Basir and al-Hasan ibn Shihab: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “There is no zakat on less than five awsaq, and the wasq is sixty sa’.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالاَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» لَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ زَكَاةٌ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah and Bukayr, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “As for whatever the earth produces of any crop, there is no zakat in it except in four things: wheat, barley, dates, and raisins. Nothing is due on any of these four things until it reaches five awsaq. One wasq is sixty sa’, making three hundred sa‘ according to the sa‘ of the blessed Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. So if any one of these categories is less than five awsaq, even by a small amount, then nothing is due on it. If the wheat, barley, dates, or raisins fall short of five awsaq by one sa’ or by part of a sa’, then nothing is due on it. Then if it is managed by ropes (al-risha), water-drawing (al-nadh), and buckets (al-dila), then in it is half of the tenth (5%). And if it is watered without labour, by a river or other than it, or by the sky, then in it is the full tenth (10%).”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَبُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» وَ أَمَّا مَا أَنْبَتَتِ اَلْأَرْضُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلْأَشْيَاءِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ إِلاَّ فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ اَلْبُرِّ وَ اَلشَّعِيرِ وَ اَلتَّمْرِ وَ اَلزَّبِيبِ وَ لَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ اَلْأَرْبَعَةِ اَلْأَشْيَاءِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ وَاَلْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعاً وَ هُوَ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ صَاعٍ بِصَاعِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِي كُلِّ صِنْفٍ خَمْسَةُ أَوْسَاقٍ غَيْرَ شَيْءٍ وَ إِنْ قَلَّ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ وَ إِنْ نَقَصَ اَلْبُرُّ وَ اَلشَّعِيرُ وَ اَلتَّمْرُ وَ اَلزَّبِيبُ أَوْ نَقَصَ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ صَاعٌ أَوْ بَعْضُ صَاعٍ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا كَانَ يُعَالَجُ بِالرِّشَاءِ وَاَلنَّضْحِ وَاَلدِّلاَءِ فَفِيهِ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يُسْقَى بِغَيْرِ عِلاَجٍ بِنَهْرٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ أَوْ سَمَاءٍ فَفِيهِ اَلْعُشْرُ تَامّاً«.

items.e: Ali ibn Jafar asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, about ‘an orchard whose produce is not sold, though if it were sold, its produce would amount to wealth. Is charity obligatory in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, if it is eaten.”
items.o: وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْبُسْتَانِ لاَ تُبَاعُ غَلَّتُهُ وَ لَوْ بِيعَتْ بَلَغَتْ غَلَّتُهَا مَالاً فَهَلْ تَجِبُ فِيهِ صَدَقَةٌ قَالَ» لاَ إِذَا كَانَتْ تُؤْكَلُ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran from Asim ibn Humayd, and al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Asim ibn Humayd from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah: I (narrator) asked Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s) about ‘zakat.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing due on fewer than five camels. When they reach five camels, one sheep is due on them, up to ten camels. When they reach ten camels, two sheep are due on them, up to fifteen camels. When they reach fifteen camels, three sheep are due on them, up to twenty camels. When they reach twenty, four sheep are due on them, up to twenty-five camels. When they reach twenty-five camels, five sheep are due on them. Then, if they increase by one, a she-camel in its second year (ibnat makhad) is due on them, up to thirty-five camels. If there is no she-camel in its second year, then a male camel in its third year (ibn labun) is due. Then, if they increase by one beyond thirty-five, a female camel in its third year (bint labun) is due on them, up to forty-five camels. Then, if they increase by one beyond forty-five, a she-camel in its fourth year (hiqqah) is due on them, up to sixty camels. Then, if they increase by one beyond sixty, a she-camel in its fifth year (jadhah) is due on them, up to seventy-five camels. Then, if they increase by one beyond seventy-five, two female camels in their third year (binta labun) are due on them, up to ninety camels. Then, if they increase by one beyond ninety, two she-camels in their fourth year (hiqqatan) are due on them, up to one hundred and twenty camels. Then, when the camels become numerous, then for every fifty camels, one she-camel in its fourth year (hiqqah) is due. An old animal is not to be taken for zakat, nor an animal with a defect, unless the collector of charity wishes to count both its young and its old.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ وَاَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَقَالَ» لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْخَمْسِ مِنَ اَلْإِبِلِ شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ خَمْساً فَفِيهَا شَاةٌ إِلَى عَشْرٍ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ عَشْراً فَفِيهَا شَاتَانِ إِلَى خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ فَفِيهَا ثَلاَثٌ مِنَ اَلْغَنَمِ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ عِشْرِينَ فَفِيهَا أَرْبَعٌ مِنَ اَلْغَنَمِ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ خَمْساً وَ عِشْرِينَ فَفِيهَا خَمْسٌ مِنَ اَلْغَنَمِ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَةُ مَخَاضٍ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنِ اِبْنَةُ مَخَاضٍ فَابْنُ لَبُونٍ ذَكَرٌ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ عَلَى خَمْسٍ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَةُ لَبُونٍ أُنْثَى إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا حِقَّةٌ إِلَى سِتِّينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا جَذَعَةٌ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَسَبْعِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا بِنْتَا لَبُونٍ إِلَى تِسْعِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا حِقَّتَانِ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةٍ فَإِذَا كَثُرَتِ اَلْإِبِلُ فَفِي كُلِّ خَمْسِينَ حِقَّةٌ وَلاَ تُؤْخَذُ هَرِمَةٌ وَ لاَ ذَاتُ عَوَارٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشَاءَ اَلْمُصَدِّقُ أَنْ يَعُدَّ صَغِيرَهَا وَكَبِيرَهَا«.

items.e: And from him, from Abu Jafar, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “In five young she-camels (qilas), one sheep is due, and there is nothing due on fewer than five. In ten, two sheep are due; in fifteen, three; in twenty, four; and in twenty-five, five. In twenty-six, a she-camel in its second year (ibnat makhad) is due, up to thirty-five. Then, if they increase by one, a female camel in its third year (ibnat labun) is due, up to forty-five. Then, if they increase by one, a she-camel in its fourth year (hiqqah) is due, up to sixty. Then, if they increase by one, a she-camel in its fifth year (jadhah) is due, up to seventy-five. Then, if they increase by one, two female camels in their third year (ibnata labun) are due, up to ninety. Then, if they increase by one, two she-camels in their fourth year (hiqqatan) are due, up to one hundred and twenty. Then, when the camels become numerous, for every fifty there is a she-camel in its fourth year (hiqqah).”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي خَمْسِ قِلاَصٍ شَاةٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْخَمْسِ شَيْءٌ وَفِي عَشْرٍ شَاتَانِ وَ فِي خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ ثَلاَثٌ وَ فِي عِشْرِينَ أَرْبَعٌ وَ فِي خَمْسٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ خَمْسٌ وَ فِي سِتٍّ وَ عِشْرِينَ اِبْنَةُ مَخَاضٍ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَةُ لَبُونٍ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ أَرْبَعِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا حِقَّةٌ إِلَى سِتِّينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا جَذَعَةٌ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ سَبْعِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَتَا لَبُونٍ إِلَى تِسْعِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا حِقَّتَانِ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةٍ فَإِذَا كَثُرَتِ اَلْإِبِلُ فَفِي كُلِّ خَمْسِينَ حِقَّةٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from al-Qasim ibn Urwah, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing due on camels until they reach five. When they reach five, one sheep is due on them. Then, for every five camels, one sheep is due, until they reach twenty-five. Then, if they increase by one, a she-camel in its second year (ibnat makhad) is due on them. If there is no she-camel in its second year (ibnat makhad) among them, then a male camel in its third year (ibn labun) is due, up to thirty-five. Then, if they increase beyond thirty-five, a female camel in its third year (ibnat labun) is due, up to forty-five. Then, if they increase, a she-camel in its fourth year (hiqqah) is due, up to sixty. Then, if they increase, a she-camel in its fifth year (jadhah) is due, up to seventy-five. Then, if they increase, two female camels in their third year (binta labun) are due, up to ninety. Then, if they increase, two she-camels in their fourth year (hiqqatan) are due, up to one hundred and twenty. Then, if they increase beyond that, then for every fifty camels, one she-camel in its fourth year (hiqqah) is due, and for every forty camels, one female camel in its third year (ibnat labun) is due. There is no zakat on any animals other than these categories which we have named. And whatever belongs to these categories but is kept domestically (al-dawajin) or used as working animals (al-awamil), there is nothing due on them. And as for these three categories, camels, cattle, and sheep, nothing is due on them until a full year has passed over them from the day they were born.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» لَيْسَ فِي اَلْإِبِلِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ خَمْساً فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْساً فَفِيهَا شَاةٌ ثُمَّ فِي كُلِّ خَمْسٍ شَاةٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ خَمْساً وَ عِشْرِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَةُ مَخَاضٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهَا اِبْنَةُ مَخَاضٍ فَابْنُ لَبُونٍ ذَكَرٌ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى خَمْسٍ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَابْنَةُ لَبُونٍ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ أَرْبَعِينَ فَإِنْ زَادَتْ فَحِقَّةٌ إِلَى سِتِّينَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ فَجَذَعَةٌ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ سَبْعِينَ فَإِنْ زَادَتْ فَبِنْتَا لَبُونٍ إِلَى تِسْعِينَ فَإِنْ زَادَتْ فَحِقَّتَانِ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةٍ فَإِنْ زَادَتْ فَفِي كُلِّ خَمْسِينَ حِقَّةٌ وَ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ اِبْنَةُ لَبُونٍ وَ لَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلْحَيَوَانِ زَكَاةٌ غَيْرِ هَذِهِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ اَلَّتِي سَمَّيْنَاهَا وَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ كَانَ مِنْ هَذِهِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ مِنَ اَلدَّوَاجِنِ وَ اَلْعَوَامِلِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ هَذِهِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ اَلثَّلاَثَةِ اَلْإِبِلِ وَاَلْبَقَرِ وَاَلْغَنَمِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهَا اَلْحَوْلُ مِنْ يَوْمِ يُنْتَجُ«.

items.e: As for the report which Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Abu Basir and Burayd al-Ijli and al-Fudayl from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the charity of camels, for every five camels, one sheep is due, until they reach twenty-five. Then, when they reach that number, a she-camel in its second year (ibnat makhad) is due on them, and nothing further is due on them until they reach thirty-five. Then, when they reach thirty-five, a female camel in its third year (ibnat labun) is due on them, and nothing further is due until they reach forty-five. Then, when they reach forty-five, a she-camel in its fourth year, ready for the male to mate with (hiqqah taruqat al-fahl), is due on them, and nothing further is due until they reach sixty. Then, when they reach sixty, a she-camel in its fifth year (jadhah) is due on them, and nothing further is due until they reach seventy-five. Then, when they reach seventy-five, two female camels in their third year (ibnata labun) are due on them, and nothing further is due until they reach ninety. Then, when they reach ninety, two she-camels in their fourth year, ready for the male to mate with (hiqqatan taruqata al-fahl), are due on them, and nothing further is due until they reach one hundred and twenty. Then, when they reach one hundred and twenty, two she-camels in their fourth year, ready for the male to mate with (hiqqatan taruqata al-fahl), are due on them. Then, when they increase by one beyond one hundred and twenty, then for every fifty camels, one she-camel in its fourth year (hiqqah) is due, and for every forty camels, one female camel in its third year (bint labun) is due. Then the camels return according to their ages. Nothing is due on the excess amount (al-nayyif), nothing is due on fractions, and nothing is due on working animals (al-awamil). This is only due on grazing, pasturing animals.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Then what is due on grazing Bactrian camels (al-bukht al-saimah)?’” The Imam (a.s.) said: “The same as what is due on Arabian camels.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا اَلْخَبَرُ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ بُرَيْدٍ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» فِي صَدَقَةِ اَلْإِبِلِ فِي كُلِّ خَمْسٍ شَاةٌ إِلَى أَنْ تَبْلُغَ خَمْساً وَ عِشْرِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ ذَلِكَ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَةُ مَخَاضٍ وَ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ خَمْساً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْساً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَةُ لَبُونٍ ثُمَّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ خَمْساً وَ أَرْبَعِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْساً وَ أَرْبَعِينَ فَفِيهَا حِقَّةٌ طَرُوقَةُ اَلْفَحْلِ ثُمَّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ سِتِّينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ سِتِّينَ فَفِيهَا جَذَعَةٌ ثُمَّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ خَمْساً وَ سَبْعِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْساً وَ سَبْعِينَ فَفِيهَا اِبْنَتَا لَبُونٍ ثُمَّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ تِسْعِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ تِسْعِينَ فَفِيهَا حِقَّتَانِ طَرُوقَتَا اَلْفَحْلِ ثُمَّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةً فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةً فَفِيهَا حِقَّتَانِ طَرُوقَتَا اَلْفَحْلِ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ عَلَى عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةٍ فَفِي كُلِّ خَمْسِينَ حِقَّةٌ وَ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ بِنْتُ لَبُونٍ ثُمَّ تَرْجِعُ اَلْإِبِلُ عَلَى أَسْنَانِهَا وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلنَّيِّفِ شَيْءٌ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْكُسُورِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْعَوَامِلِ شَيْءٌ وَ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ عَلَى اَلسَّائِمَةِ اَلرَّاعِيَةِ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَا فِي اَلْبُخْتِ اَلسَّائِمَةِ قَالَ» مِثْلُ مَا فِي اَلْإِبِلِ اَلْعَرَبِيَّةِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all together from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “In five young she-camels (qala’is), one sheep is due, and there is nothing due on fewer than five. In ten, two sheep are due; in fifteen, three sheep; in twenty, four sheep; in twenty-five, five sheep; and in twenty-six, a female camel in its second year (bint makhad) is due, up to thirty-five.” Abd al-Rahman said: “This is a difference between us and the people.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي خَمْسِ قَلاَئِصَ شَاةٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْخَمْسِ شَيْءٌ وَفِي عَشْرٍ شَاتَانِ وَفِي خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ ثَلاَثُ شِيَاهٍ وَفِي عِشْرِينَ أَرْبَعُ شِيَاهٍ وَفِي خَمْسٍ وَعِشْرِينَ خَمْسُ شِيَاهٍ وَ فِي سِتٍّ وَ عِشْرِينَ بِنْتُ مَخَاضٍ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ« وَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اَلرَّحْمَنِ هَذَا فَرْقٌ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ اَلنَّاسِ.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Abu Basir and Burayd and al-Fudayl from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding cattle ,in every thirty cows, a yearling calf (tabi hawli) is due, and there is nothing due on fewer than that. In forty cows, an older cow (musinnah) is due, and there is nothing due between thirty and forty until it reaches forty. Then, when it reaches forty, an older cow (musinnah) is due on it. There is nothing due between forty and sixty cattle. Then, when it reaches sixty cattle, two yearling calves (tabian) are due, up to seventy. Then, when it reaches seventy, a yearling calf (tabi) and an older cow (musinnah) are due, up to eighty. Then, when it reaches eighty cattle, then for every forty, an older cow (musinnah) is due. Then, when it reaches ninety cattle, three yearling calves (hawliyyat) are due. Then, when it reaches one hundred and twenty cattle, then for every forty, an older cow (musinnah) is due. Then the cattle return according to their age categories. There is nothing due on the excess amount (al-nayyif), nothing due on fractions, and nothing due on working animals (al-awamil). Charity is only due on grazing, pasturing animals. And as for anything over which a full year has not passed while it is with its owner, there is nothing due on it until a full year passes over it. Then, when a full year passes over it, zakat becomes obligatory on it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ بُرَيْدٍ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» فِي اَلْبَقَرِ فِي كُلِّ ثَلاَثِينَ بَقَرَةً تَبِيعٌ حَوْلِيٌّ وَ لَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ وَ فِي أَرْبَعِينَ بَقَرَةً بَقَرَةٌ مُسِنَّةٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا بَيْنَ اَلثَّلاَثِينَ إِلَى اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ أَرْبَعِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ أَرْبَعِينَ فَفِيهَا مُسِنَّةٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا بَيْنَ اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ إِلَى اَلسِّتِّينَ شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتِ اَلسِّتِّينَ فَفِيهَا تَبِيعَانِ إِلَى سَبْعِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتِ اَلسَّبْعِينَ فَفِيهَا تَبِيعٌ وَمُسِنَّةٌ إِلَى اَلثَّمَانِينَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ ثَمَانِينَ فَفِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ مُسِنَّةٌ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ تِسْعِينَ فَفِيهَا ثَلاَثُ حَوْلِيَّاتٍ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةً فَفِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ مُسِنَّةٌ ثُمَّ تَرْجِعُ اَلْبَقَرُ عَلَى أَسْنَانِهَا وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلنَّيِّفِ شَيْءٌ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْكُسُورِ شَيْءٌ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْعَوَامِلِ شَيْ ءٌإِنَّمَا اَلصَّدَقَةُ عَلَى اَلسَّائِمَةِ اَلرَّاعِيَةِ وَ كُلُّ مَا لَمْ يَحُلْ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ فَإِذَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَجَبَتْ فِيهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah, Muhammad ibn Muslim, Abu Basir and Burayd al-Ijli and al-Fudayl from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s): Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding sheep, in every forty sheep, one sheep is due, and there is nothing due on fewer than forty. Then nothing further is due on them until they reach one hundred and twenty (sheep). When they reach 120 (sheep), the same ruling applies: one sheep is due. Then, if they increase beyond one hundred and twenty (sheep), two sheep are due on them, and nothing more than two sheep is due until they reach two hundred. Then, when they reach two hundred (sheep), the same ruling applies. Then, if they increase beyond two hundred (sheep) by one sheep, three sheep are due on them. Then nothing more than that is due until they reach three hundred (sheep). When they reach three hundred (sheep), the same ruling applies: three sheep are due. Then, if they increase by one, four sheep are due on them, until they reach 400 (sheep). Then, when four hundred (sheep) is complete, for every one hundred sheep, one sheep is due, and the previous calculation is dropped. Nothing is due on anything less than one hundred (sheep) after that, and nothing is due on the excess amount (al-nayyif).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ بُرَيْدٍ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ وَاَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:» فِي اَلشَّاةِ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ شَاةً شَاةٌ وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ شَيْءٌ ثُمَّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةً فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةً فَفِيهَا مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ شَاةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةٍ فَفِيهَا شَاتَانِ وَلَيْسَ فِيهَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْ شَاتَيْنِ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ مِائَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتِ اَلْمِائَتَيْنِ فَفِيهَا مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى اَلْمِائَتَيْنِ شَاةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا ثَلاَثُ شِيَاهٍ ثُمَّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْ ءٌأَكْثَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ ثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ ثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ فَفِيهَا مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثُ شِيَاهٍ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا أَرْبَعُ شِيَاهٍ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ أَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ فَإِذَا تَمَّتْ أَرْبَعُمِائَةٍ كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ مِائَةٍ شَاةٌ وَ سَقَطَ اَلْأَمْرُ اَلْأَوَّلُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى مَا دُونَ اَلْمِائَةِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ فِي اَلنَّيِّفِ شَيْءٌ« وَ قَالاَ» كُلُّ مَا لاَ يَحُولُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ فَإِذَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ«.
items.h: Chapter on Zakat of Sheep or Goats

items.e: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran from Asim ibn Humayd, and al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Asim ibn Humayd from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing due on fewer than forty sheep. When they reach forty, one sheep is due on them, up to one hundred and twenty. Then, if they increase by one, two sheep are due on them, up to two hundred. Then, if they increase by one, three sheep are due on them, up to three hundred. Then, when the sheep become numerous, for every one hundred sheep, one sheep is due. An old animal is not to be taken, nor one with a defect, unless the collector of charity wishes. What is gathered together is not to be separated, and what is separated is not to be gathered together. Its young and its old are counted.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ مِنَ اَلْغَنَمِ شَيْءٌ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ أَرْبَعِينَ فَفِيهَا شَاةٌ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ وَ مِائَةٍ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا شَاتَانِ إِلَى اَلْمِائَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا زَادَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ فَفِيهَا ثَلاَثٌ مِنَ اَلْغَنَمِ إِلَى ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ فَإِذَا كَثُرَتِ اَلْغَنَمُ فَفِي كُلِّ مِائَةٍ شَاةٌ وَ لاَ تُؤْخَذُ هَرِمَةٌ وَ لاَ ذَاتُ عَوَارٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشَاءَ اَلْمُصَدِّقُ وَ لاَ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ مُجْتَمِعٍ وَ لاَ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ مُتَفَرِّقٍ وَ يَعُدُّ صَغِيرَهَا وَكَبِيرَهَا«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I said to Imam (a.s): “Is there zakat upon the wealth of the orphan?” Imam (a.s) said: “If it is set aside, then there is no zakat upon it. But if you trade with it, then you are liable, and the profit belongs to the orphan.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ فِي مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» إِذَا كَانَ مَوْضُوعاً فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ فَإِذَا عَمِلْتَ بِهِ فَأَنْتَ ضَامِنٌ وَ اَلرِّبْحُ لِلْيَتِيمِ«.
items.h: Chapter on Zakat of the Wealth of Children and the Insane

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Safwan ibn Yahya and Fadala ibn Ayyub, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the wealth of the orphan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat in it.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ فَقَالَ» لَيْسَ فِيهِ زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father and al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat in the wealth of the orphan.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Yaqub al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Abu al-Hasan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “My father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) used to differ from the people regarding the wealth of the orphan: ‘there is no zakat upon it.’”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَحْمَدَ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» كَانَ أَبِي يُخَالِفُ اَلنَّاسَ فِي مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Umar ibn Abi Shubah, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘the wealth of the orphan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat upon it unless it is traded with.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ فَقَالَ» لاَ زَكَاةَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُعْمَلَ بِهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Said al-Samman, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “There is no zakat in the wealth of the orphan unless it is traded with. If it is traded with, then the profit belongs to the orphan, and if there is a loss, then it is upon the one who trades with it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ اَلسَّمَّانِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» لَيْسَ فِي مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ زَكَاةٌ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُتَّجَرَ بِهِ فَإِنِ اُتُّجِرَ بِهِ فَالرِّبْحُ لِلْيَتِيمِ وَ إِنْ وُضِعَ فَعَلَى اَلَّذِي يَتَّجِرُ بِهِ«.
