items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Yunus ibn Yaqub, who said: I sent to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, a letter saying: “I have young brothers, so when does zakat become obligatory upon their wealth?” Imam (a.s) said: “When prayer becomes obligatory upon them, zakat becomes obligatory upon them.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then as long as prayer has not become obligatory upon them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “If it is traded with, then pay zakat on it.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: أَرْسَلْتُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ لِي إِخْوَةً صِغَاراً فَمَتَى تَجِبُ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمُ اَلزَّكَاةُ قَالَ» إِذَا وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلزَّكَاةُ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَا لَمْ تَجِبْ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلصَّلاَةُ قَالَ» إِذَا اُتُّجِرَ بِهِ فَزَكُّوهُ«.

items.e: Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), about ‘young children who have wealth in the hand of their father or their brother, Is zakat obligatory upon their wealth?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is not obligatory in their wealth until it is traded with. So when it is traded with, zakat becomes obligatory. As for when it is held inactive, then there is no zakat upon it.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صِبْيَةٍ صِغَارٍ لَهُمْ مَالٌ بِيَدِ أَبِيهِمْ أَوْ أَخِيهِمْ هَلْ تَجِبُ عَلَى مَالِهِمْ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ تَجِبُ فِي مَالِهِمْ زَكَاةٌ حَتَّى يُعْمَلَ بِهِ فَإِذَا عُمِلَ بِهِ وَجَبَتِ اَلزَّكَاةُ فَأَمَّا إِذَا كَانَ مَوْقُوفاً فَلاَ زَكَاةَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, and Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, all from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu al-Utarid al-Hannat, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about ‘wealth of the orphan is with me, and I trade with it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If you move it, then its zakat is upon you.” I (narrator) asked: “I move it for eight months and leave it for four months.” Imam (a.s) said: “Its zakat is upon you.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ وَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْعُطَارِدِ اَلْحَنَّاطِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع مَالُ اَلْيَتِيمِ يَكُونُ عِنْدِي فَأَتَّجِرُ بِهِ فَقَالَ» إِذَا حَرَّكْتَهُ فَعَلَيْكَ زَكَاتُهُ« قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي أُحَرِّكُهُ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَأَدَعُهُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ قَالَ» عَلَيْكَ زَكَاتُهُ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Samaah ibn Mihran, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I said to Imam (a.s): “A man has the wealth of an orphan with him and trades with it. Is he liable for it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.” I (narrator) asked: “Then is there zakat upon him?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, by my life, I do not combine two qualities upon him: liability and zakat.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ مَالُ اَلْيَتِيمِ وَ يَتَّجِرُ بِهِ أَيَضْمَنُهُ قَالَ »نَعَمْ« قُلْتُ فَعَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ قَالَ» لاَ لَعَمْرِي لاَ أَجْمَعُ عَلَيْهِ خَصْلَتَيْنِ اَلضَّمَانَ وَ اَلزَّكَاةَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali Mahbub, from Ahmad, from al-Hasan Mahbub, from Khalid ibn Jarir, from Abu al-Rabi: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘a man in whose hand there is wealth belonging to a brother of his who is an orphan, and he is his executor. Is it proper for him to work with it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, he may work with it as he works with the wealth of someone else, and the profit is between them both.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then is there any liability upon him?’” Imam (a.s) said: “No, if he is acting with consideration for him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلرَّبِيعِ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي يَدِهِ مَالٌ لِأَخٍ لَهُ يَتِيمٍ وَ هُوَ وَصِيُّهُ أَ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ بِهِ قَالَ» نَعَمْ يَعْمَلُ بِهِ كَمَا يَعْمَلُ بِمَالِ غَيْرِهِ وَ اَلرِّبْحُ بَيْنَهُمَا« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَهَلْ عَلَيْهِ ضَمَانٌ قَالَ» لاَ إِذَا كَانَ نَاظِراً لَهُ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Mansur al-Sayqal: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about ‘the wealth of the orphan being worked with.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If you have wealth and you guarantee it, then the profit is yours, and you are liable for the wealth. But if you have no wealth and you work with it, then the profit belongs to the boy, and you are liable for the wealth.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ اَلصَّيْقَلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ يُعْمَلُ بِهِ قَالَ فَقَالَ» إِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَكَ مَالٌ وَضَمِنْتَهُ فَلَكَ اَلرِّبْحُ وَ أَنْتَ ضَامِنٌ لِلْمَالِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ لاَ مَالَ لَكَ وَ عَمِلْتَ بِهِ فَالرِّبْحُ لِلْغُلاَمِ وَ أَنْتَ ضَامِنٌ لِلْمَالِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “The wealth of the orphan has nothing upon it in specie and silent wealth (al-samit). As for the yields, then charity upon them is obligatory.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ:» مَالُ اَلْيَتِيمِ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ فِي اَلْعَيْنِ وَ اَلصَّامِتِ شَيْءٌ فَأَمَّا اَلْغَلاَّتُ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهَا اَلصَّدَقَةَ وَاجِبَةً«.

items.e: As for what Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “There is no zakat in the wealth of the orphan, and there is no prayer upon him, and there is no zakat upon all of his yields from date-palms, or crops, or produce. And if he (the orphan) reaches maturity, then there is no zakat upon him for what has passed, nor is there upon him for what is to come until he reaches maturity. So when he (the orphan) reaches maturity, one zakat becomes due upon him, and there is upon him the same as what is upon other people.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» لَيْسَ فِي مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ زَكَاةٌ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةٌ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ غَلاَّتِهِ مِنْ نَخْلٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ أَوْ غَلَّةٍ زَكَاةٌ وَ إِنْ بَلَغَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ لِمَا مَضَى زَكَاةٌ وَ لاَ عَلَيْهِ لِمَا يَسْتَقْبِلُ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَ فَإِذَا أَدْرَكَ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ وَ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ مَا عَلَى غَيْرِهِ مِنَ اَلنَّاسِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ibn al-Fudayl al-Basri: I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), asking him about ‘the executor (of orphans wealth), Does he pay zakat al-fitrah on behalf of the orphans if they have wealth?’ Imam (a.s) wrote: “There is no zakat upon the wealth of the orphan.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ اَلْبَصْرِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْوَصِيِّ يُزَكِّي زَكَاةَ اَلْفِطْرَةِ عَنِ اَلْيَتَامَى إِذَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مَالٌ فَكَتَبَ» لاَ زَكَاةَ عَلَى مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A woman from among our people is mentally confused (mukhtalitah), ‘Is there zakat upon her?’” Imam (a.s) said: “If it has been traded with, then zakat is upon her, and if it has not been traded with, then no.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اِمْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِنَا مُخْتَلِطَةٌ عَلَيْهَا زَكَاةٌ »إِ نْ كَانَ عُمِلَ بِهِ فَعَلَيْهَا زَكَاةٌ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يُعْمَلْ بِهِ فَلاَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Musa ibn Bakr, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘an afflicted woman (musabah) who has wealth in the hand of her brother, Is there zakat upon it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If her brother trades with it, then zakat is upon it.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ مُصَابَةٍ وَ لَهَا مَالٌ فِي يَدِ أَخِيهَا فَهَلْ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ أَخُوهَا يَتَّجِرُ بِهِ فَعَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from his two brothers, from their father, from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from the one who narrated it, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said: Imam (a.s) said regarding ‘a man whose wealth is absent from him and he is not able to take possession of it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then there is no zakat upon him until it comes out. So when it comes out, he pays zakat on it for one year. But if he leaves it deliberately while he is able to take possession of it, then zakat is upon him for every one of the years that has passed over it.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَخَوَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْجَهْمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي رَجُلٍ مَالُهُ عَنْهُ غَائِبٌ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَخْذِهِ قَالَ» فَلاَ زَكَاةَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ زَكَّاهُ لِعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَدَعُهُ مُتَعَمِّداً وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَخْذِهِ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ لِكُلِّ مَا مَرَّ بِهِ مِنَ اَلسِّنِينَ«.
items.h: Chapter on Zakat of the Wealth of the Absent Person, Debt, and Loan

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no charity upon a debt, nor upon wealth that is absent from you, until it falls into your hands.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ صَدَقَةَ عَلَى اَلدَّيْنِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْمَالِ اَلْغَائِبِ عَنْكَ حَتَّى يَقَعَ فِي يَدَيْكَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaah, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man whose wealth is absent from him for five years, then it comes to him, and the principal of the wealth is not returned to him. How much does he pay zakat on it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “For one year.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَغِيبُ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ خَمْسَ سِنِينَ ثُمَّ يَأْتِيهِ وَ لاَ يُرَدُّ عَلَيْهِ رَأْسُ اَلْمَالِ كَمْ يُزَكِّيهِ قَالَ» سَنَةً وَاحِدَةً«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “Is there is no zakat in debt?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ لَيْسَ فِي اَلدَّيْنِ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Durust, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat in debt unless the owner of the debt is the one who delays it. But if he is not able to take possession of it, then there is no zakat upon him until he receives it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ دُرُسْتَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي اَلدَّيْنِ زَكَاةٌ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ صَاحِبُ اَلدَّيْنِ هُوَ اَلَّذِي يُؤَخِّرُهُ فَإِذَا كَانَ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَخْذِهِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad and Muhammad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Maysarah, from Abd al-Aziz, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who has a debt, Does he pay zakat on it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Every debt that he leaves, while if he wanted to take it he could take it, then its zakat is upon him. But whatever he is not able to take, then there is no zakat upon him.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْعَزِيزِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ اَلدَّيْنُ أَيُزَكِّيهِ قَالَ» كُلُّ دَيْنٍ يَدَعُهُ هُوَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَخْذَهُ فَعَلَيْهِ زَكَاتُهُ وَ مَا كَانَ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَخْذِهِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) was asked regarding ‘a man who borrowed wealth, then a year passed over it while it was with him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If the one who lent it pays its zakat, then there is no zakat upon him, but if he does not pay it, the borrower pays it.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ اِسْتَقْرَضَ مَالاً فَحَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَ هُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ اَلَّذِي أَقْرَضَهُ يُؤَدِّي زَكَاتَهُ فَلاَ زَكَاةَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ لاَ يُؤَدِّي أَدَّى اَلْمُسْتَقْرِضُ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ali ibn al-Numan, from Yaqub ibn Shuayb, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who lends wealth to another man for one year, two years, three years, or whatever Allah (swt) wills. Thus, upon whom is the zakat, upon the lender or upon the borrower?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon the borrower, because its benefit belongs to him, so its zakat is upon him.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُقْرِضُ اَلْمَالَ لِلرَّجُلِ اَلسَّنَةَ وَاَلسَّنَتَيْنِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَ أَوْ مَا شَاءَ اَللَّهُ عَلَى مَنِ اَلزَّكَاةُ عَلَى اَلْمُقْرِضِ أَوْ عَلَى اَلْمُسْتَقْرِضِ فَقَالَ» عَلَى اَلْمُسْتَقْرِضِ لِأَنَّ لَهُ نَفْعَهُ فَعَلَيْهِ زَكَاتُهُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said: I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man gave wealth to another man as a loan; upon whom is its zakat, upon the lender or upon the borrower?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, rather its zakat, if it has been placed with him for a year, is upon the borrower.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then is its zakat not upon the lender?’” Imam (a.s) said: “No. Wealth is not paid zakat on from two sides in one year, and there is nothing upon the one who gives it, because there is nothing in his hand, for the wealth is in the hand of the other. So whoever has the wealth in his hand pays zakat on it.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Does he then pay zakat on the wealth of someone else from his own wealth?’” Imam (a.s) said: “It is his wealth as long as it is in his hand, and that wealth does not belong to anyone other than him.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “O Zurarah, have you considered the loss of that wealth and its profit, whose are they, and upon whom are they?” I (narrator) replied: “They belong to the borrower.” Imam (a.s) said: “Then the surplus belongs to him, and the deficiency is upon him, and he may clothe himself, marry, and eat from it. And it is not proper for him not to pay zakat on it. Rather, he should pay zakat on it, for it is upon him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ دَفَعَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مَالاً قَرْضاً عَلَى مَنْ زَكَاتُهُ أَ عَلَى اَلْمُقْرِضِ أَوْ عَلَى اَلْمُقْتَرِضِ قَالَ» لاَ بَلْ زَكَاتُهَا إِنْ كَانَتْ مَوْضُوعَةً عِنْدَهُ حَوْلاً عَلَى اَلْمُقْتَرِضِ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَلَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْمُقْرِضِ زَكَاتُهَا قَالَ» لاَ لاَ يُزَكَّى اَلْمَالُ مِنْ وَجْهَيْنِ فِي عَامٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلدَّافِعِ شَيْءٌ لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي يَدِهِ شَيْءٌ لِأَنَّ اَلْمَالَ فِي يَدِ اَلْآخَرِ فَمَنْ كَانَ اَلْمَالُ فِي يَدِهِ زَكَّاهُ« قَالَ قُلْتُ أَفَيُزَكِّي مَالَ غَيْرِهِ مِنْ مَالِهِ فَقَالَ» إِنَّهُ مَالُهُ مَا دَامَ فِي يَدِهِ وَ لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ اَلْمَالُ لِأَحَدٍ غَيْرِهِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» يَا زُرَارَةُ أَ رَأَيْتَ وَضِيعَةُ ذَلِكَ اَلْمَالِ وَ رِبْحُهُ لِمَنْ هُوَ وَ عَلَى مَنْ« قُلْتُ لِلْمُقْتَرِضِ قَالَ» فَلَهُ اَلْفَضْلُ وَ عَلَيْهِ اَلنُّقْصَانُ وَ لَهُ أَنْ يَلْبَسَ وَيَنْكِحَ وَ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ وَ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ لاَ يُزَكِّيَهُ بَلْ يُزَكِّيهِ فَإِنَّهُ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Hasan ibn Atiyyah, who said: I (narrator) said to Hisham ibn Ahmar: “I would like you to ask Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, for me: ‘There are loans belonging to some people with me, and they do not demand them from me; is there zakat upon me?’” Imam (a.s) said: “You do not repay, and you do not pay zakat? Pay zakat.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِهِشَامِ بْنِ أَحْمَرَ أُحِبُّ أَنْ تَسْأَلَ لِي أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ لِقَوْمٍ عِنْدِي قُرُوضاً لَيْسَ يَطْلُبُونَهَا مِنِّي أَفَعَلَيَّ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ تَقْضِي وَ لاَ تُزَكِّي زَكِّ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said and al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is there zakat upon debt?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, until he receives it.” I (narrator) asked: “Then when he receives it, does he pay zakat on it?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, until a year passes over it in his hands.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلدَّيْنُ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ« قُلْتُ فَإِذَا قَبَضَهُ أَ يُزَكِّيهِ فَقَالَ» لاَ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ فِي يَدَيْهِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man has a deposit and a debt, but he does not reach them, then he takes them. When does zakat become obligatory upon him?” Imam (a.s) said: “When he takes them, then a year passes over them, he pays zakat.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي مَحْمُودٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ لَهُ اَلْوَدِيعَةُ وَ اَلدَّيْنُ فَلاَ يَصِلُ إِلَيْهِمَا ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُهُمَا مَتَى تَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ قَالَ» إِذَا أَخَذَهُمَا ثُمَّ يَحُولُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ يُزَكِّي«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who inherited wealth while the man was absent, Is there zakat upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, until he arrives.” I (narrator) asked: “Does he pay zakat on it when he arrives?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, not until a year passes over it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ وَرِثَ مَالاً وَ اَلرَّجُلُ غَائِبٌ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ قَالَ» لاَ حَتَّى يَقْدَمَ« قُلْتُ أَ يُزَكِّيهِ حِينَ يَقْدَمُ قَالَ» لاَ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said: Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is upon silent wealth (al-mal al-samit) over which a year passes and which he has not moved.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: »اَلزَّكَاةُ عَلَى اَلْمَالِ اَلصَّامِتِ اَلَّذِي يَحُولُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَ لَمْ يُحَرِّكْهُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who acquires wealth.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then he does not pay zakat on it until a year passes over it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُفِيدُ اَلْمَالَ قَالَ» فَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man had two hundred dirhams minus one dirham with him for eleven months, then after that, in the twelfth month, he acquired one dirham, so that two hundred dirhams became complete with him; ‘Is their zakat upon him?’” Imam (a.s) said: “No, not until a year passes over it while it is two hundred dirhams. So if it was one hundred and fifty dirhams, then he acquired fifty after one month had passed, then there is no zakat upon him until a year passes over the two hundred.” I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “Then if he had two hundred dirhams minus one dirham with him, and some days passed over them before the month ended, then he acquired one dirham, and a year came over the dirhams together with the dirham, is there zakat upon him?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. But if a full year has not passed over all of them together, then there is nothing upon him in them.” He (narrator) said that Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Any man who has wealth and a year passes over it, then he pays zakat on it.” I said to Imam (a.s): “Then if he gives it away as a gift one month or two days before its due time.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is never anything upon him.” He (narrator) said that Zurarah said from Imam (a.s) that he said: Imam (a.s) said: “This is only like a man who broke his fast in the month of Ramadan for one day while he was in his residence, then he goes out at the end of the day on a journey, intending by that journey to invalidate the expiation that had become obligatory upon him.” And Imam (a.s) said: “When he saw the twelfth crescent, zakat became obligatory upon him. But if he had given it away as a gift before that, it would have been permissible, and there would have been nothing upon him, like one who goes out and then breaks his fast. He only cannot prevent what a year has passed over. As for what a year has not passed over, he may prevent it, and it is not lawful for him to prevent the wealth of another in what has already become due upon it.” Zurarah said: “So I said to Imam (a.s): ‘A man had two hundred dirhams, so he gave them as a gift to some of his brothers, or his children, or his family, fleeing thereby from zakat, and he did that one month before it became due.’” Imam (a.s) said: “When the twelfth month enters, then a year has passed over it, and zakat has become obligatory upon him in it.” So I (Zurarah) said to Imam (a.s): “Then if he does something with it before the year?” Imam (a.s) said: “That is permissible for him.” I (Zurarah) asked: “He fled thereby from zakat.” Imam (a.s) said: “What he has brought upon himself is greater than what he prevented from its zakat.” So I (Zurarah) said to Imam (a.s): “He is able to get it back.” Imam (a.s) said: “And what is it upon me that he is able to get it back, when it has gone out of his ownership?” I said: “Then he gave it to him upon a condition.” Imam (a.s) said: “When he names it a gift, the gift is valid, the condition falls away, and he is liable for the zakat.” I said to Imam (a.s): “And how does the condition fall away, the gift take effect, and he become liable for the zakat?” Imam (a.s) said: “This is an invalid condition, and the guaranteed gift is effective, and the zakat is binding upon him as a punishment for him.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “That is only for him when he buys with it a house, or land, or estates.” Then Zurarah said: “I said to Imam (a.s): “Your father said to me: ‘Whoever flees thereby from zakat, then he must pay it.’” Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, spoke the truth. He must pay what has been made obligatory upon him, and what has not become obligatory upon him, then there is nothing upon him in it.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Have you considered, if a man were overcome by unconsciousness for a day and then died, so his prayer passed away, would it be upon him, while he has died, to perform it?” I (Zurarah) replied: “No, unless he had regained consciousness during his day.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “If a man became ill in the month of Ramadan and then died in it, would fasting be performed on his behalf?” I (Zurarah) replied: “No.” Imam (a.s) said: “So likewise, the man does not pay from his wealth except that over which a year has passed.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مِائَتَا دِرْهَمٍ غَيْرَ دِرْهَمٍ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ شَهْراً ثُمَّ أَصَابَ دِرْهَماً بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ اَلثَّانِيَ عَشَرَ فَكَمَلَتْ عِنْدَهُ مِائَتَا دِرْهَمٍ أَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاتُهَا قَالَ» لاَ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَ هِيَ مِائَتَا دِرْهَمٍ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِائَةً وَ خَمْسِينَ دِرْهَماً فَأَصَابَ خَمْسِينَ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَمْضِيَ شَهْرٌ فَلاَ زَكَاةَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَى اَلْمِائَتَيْنِ اَلْحَوْلُ« قُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ مِائَتَا دِرْهَمٍ غَيْرَ دِرْهَمٍ فَمَضَى عَلَيْهَا أَيَّامٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْقَضِيَ اَلشَّهْرُ ثُمَّ أَصَابَ دِرْهَماً فَأَتَى عَلَى اَلدَّرَاهِمِ مَعَ اَلدِّرْهَمِ حَوْلٌ أَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَمْضِ عَلَيْهَا جَمِيعاً اَلْحَوْلُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا« قَالَ قَالَ زُرَارَةُ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ وَ حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ فَإِنَّهُ يُزَكِّيهِ« قُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنْ وَهَبَهُ قَبْلَ حَلِّهِ بِشَهْرٍ أَوْ بِيَوْمَيْنِ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْ ءٌأَبَداً« قَالَ وَ قَالَ زُرَارَةُ عَنْهُ إِنَّهُ قَالَ» إِنَّمَا هَذَا بِمَنْزِلَةِ رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ يَوْماً فِي إِقَامَتِهِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ فِي آخِرِ اَلنَّهَارِ فِي سَفَرٍ فَأَرَادَ بِسَفَرِهِ ذَلِكَ إِبْطَالَ اَلْكَفَّارَةِ اَلَّتِي وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ« وَ قَالَ» إِنَّهُ حِينَ رَأَى اَلْهِلاَلَ اَلثَّانِيَ عَشَرَ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَ لَكِنَّهُ لَوْ كَانَ وَهَبَهَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لَجَازَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ خَرَجَ ثُمَّ أَفْطَرَ إِنَّمَا لاَ يَمْنَعُ مَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ فَأَمَّا مَا لَمْ يَحُلْ عَلَيْهِ فَلَهُ مَنْعُهُ وَ لاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ مَنْعُ مَالِ غَيْرِهِ فِيمَا قَدْ حَلَّ عَلَيْهِ« قَالَ زُرَارَةُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ كَانَتْ لَهُ مِائَتَا دِرْهَمٍ فَوَهَبَهَا لِبَعْضِ إِخْوَانِهِ أَوْ وُلْدِهِ أَوْ أَهْلِهِ فِرَاراً بِهَا مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ قَبْلَ حَلِّهَا بِشَهْرٍ فَقَالَ» إِذَا دَخَلَ اَلشَّهْرُ اَلثَّانِيَ عَشَرَ فَقَدْ حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا اَلزَّكَاةُ« فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنْ أَحْدَثَ فِيهَا قَبْلَ اَلْحَوْلِ قَالَ» جَازَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ« قُلْتُ إِنَّهُ فَرَّ بِهَا عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ قَالَ» مَا أَدْخَلَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَعْظَمُ مِمَّا مَنَعَ مِنْ زَكَاتِهَا« فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّهُ يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ فَقَالَ» وَ مَا عَلَيَّ إِنَّهُ يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهَا وَ قَدْ خَرَجَتْ مِنْ مِلْكِهِ« قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ دَفَعَهَا إِلَيْهِ عَلَى شَرْطٍ فَقَالَ» إِنَّهُ إِذَا سَمَّاهَا هِبَةً جَازَتِ اَلْهِبَةُ وَ سَقَطَ اَلشَّرْطُ وَ ضَمِنَ اَلزَّكَاةَ« قُلْتُ لَهُ وَ كَيْفَ يَسْقُطُ اَلشَّرْطُ وَ تَمْضِي اَلْهِبَةُ وَيَضْمَنُ اَلزَّكَاةَ فَقَالَ» هَذَا شَرْطٌ فَاسِدٌ وَ اَلْهِبَةُ اَلْمَضْمُونَةُ مَاضِيَةٌ وَ اَلزَّكَاةُ لَهُ لاَزِمَةٌ عُقُوبَةً لَهُ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ لَهُ إِذَا اِشْتَرَى بِهَا دَاراً أَوْ أَرْضاً أَوْ ضِيَاعاً« ثُمَّ قَالَ زُرَارَةُ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ أَبَاكَ قَالَ لِي» مَنْ فَرَّ بِهَا مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَهَا« فَقَالَ» صَدَقَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَهَا مَا أُوجِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَ مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ عَلَيْهِ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» أَ رَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً ثُمَّ مَاتَ فَذَهَبَتْ صَلاَتُهُ أَ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَدْ مَاتَ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَهَا« قُلْتُ لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدْ أَفَاقَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ» لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مَرِضَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فِيهِ أَ كَانَ يُصَامُ عَنْهُ« قُلْتُ لاَ قَالَ» فَكَذَلِكَ اَلرَّجُلُ لاَ يُؤَدِّي عَنْ مَالِهِ إِلاَّ مَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Basir and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: Both (Abu Basir and Muhammad ibn Muslim) said to Imam (a.s): “This land whose people we cultivate in partnership (sharecropping arrangement), what do you say concerning it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Every land that a ruler hands over to you, then whatever you cultivate from it, you are only liable for what Allah (swt) brings forth from it after fulfilling the share that he contracted with you upon. The tithe is not due upon everything that Allah (swt) brings forth from it. Rather, the tithe is only due upon what comes into your hand after his share has been taken from you.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ لَهُ هَذِهِ اَلْأَرْضُ اَلَّتِي نُزَارِعُ أَهْلَهَا مَا تَرَى فِيهَا فَقَالَ» كُلُّ أَرْضٍ دَفَعَهَا إِلَيْكَ سُلْطَانٌ فَمَا حَرَثْتَهُ فِيهَا فَعَلَيْكَ فِيمَا أَخْرَجَ اَللَّهُ مِنْهَا اَلَّذِي قَاطَعَكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ مَا أَخْرَجَ اَللَّهُ مِنْهَا اَلْعُشْرُ إِنَّمَا اَلْعُشْرُ عَلَيْكَ فِيمَا يَحْصُلُ فِي يَدِكَ بَعْدَ مُقَاسَمَتِهِ لَكَ«.

items.e: As for what al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaah ibn Musa, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who has an estate and pays its land-tax (kharaj), Is there a tithe upon him in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ لَهُ اَلضَّيْعَةُ فَيُؤَدِّي خَرَاجَهَا هَلْ عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا عُشْرٌ قَالَ» لاَ«

items.e: Sa’ad, from Abu Jafar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu Kahmas, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever the ruler takes land-tax (kharaj) from, then there is no zakat upon him.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي كَهْمَسٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْهُ اَلسُّلْطَانُ اَلْخَرَاجَ فَلاَ زَكَاةَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam, from Safwan ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who both said: We (Safwan ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Muhammad) mentioned to Imam (a.s) about ‘Kufa and what had been imposed upon it of land-tax (kharaj), and what the people of his house (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) had followed concerning it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever embraces Islam willingly, his land is left in his hand, and the tithe is taken from him in what the sky and the rivers water, and half of the tithe in what is scarce (nadir) in what they cultivate of it. And whatever they do not cultivate of it, the Imam takes it and leases it (qabalah) to whoever cultivates it, and it belongs to the Muslims. And upon those who accept the ‘lease’, in their shares, is the tithe and half of the tithe. And in less than five awsaq there is nothing of zakat. And whatever is taken by the sword, that is for the Imam; he leases it according to what he sees, just as the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, did with Khaybar. He (saws) leased its ‘black’ and its ‘white’ (sawad and bayad), -meaning its land and its palm-trees. And the people say: ‘The leasing of land and palm-trees is not valid’, while the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him, leased Khaybar. And upon those who accept the lease, besides the lease payment of the land, is the tithe and half of the tithe in their shares.” And Imam (a.s) said: “The people of Taif embraced Islam, and He (saws) placed upon them the tithe and half of the tithe. And the people of Mecca, when the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, entered it by force, and they were captives in his hand, The Prophet (saws) released them and said: ‘Go, for you are the freed ones.’”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشْيَمَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالاَ: ذَكَرْنَا لَهُ اَلْكُوفَةَ وَ مَا وُضِعَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ اَلْخَرَاجِ وَ مَا سَارَ فِيهَا أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ فَقَالَ» مَنْ أَسْلَمَ طَوْعاً تُرِكَتْ أَرْضُهُ فِي يَدِهِ وَ أُخِذَ مِنْهُ اَلْعُشْرُ فِيمَا سَقَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ وَاَلْأَنْهَارُ وَ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ فِيمَا كَانَ نَادِراً فِيمَا عَمَرُوهُ مِنْهَا وَ مَا لَمْ يَعْمُرُوهُ مِنْهَا أَخَذَهُ اَلْإِمَامُ فَقَبَّلَهُ مِمَّنْ يَعْمُرُهُ وَ كَانَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ عَلَى اَلْمُتَقَبِّلِينَ فِي حِصَصِهِمُ اَلْعُشْرُ وَ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ وَ لَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ شَيْءٌ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ وَ مَا أُخِذَ بِالسَّيْفِ فَذَلِكَ إِلَى اَلْإِمَامِ يُقَبِّلُهُ بِالَّذِي يَرَاهُ كَمَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَ بِخَيْبَرَ قَبَّلَ سَوَادَهَا وَبَيَاضَهَا يَعْنِي أَرْضَهَا وَ نَخْلَهَا وَ اَلنَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ لاَ تَصْلُحُ قَبَالَةُ اَلْأَرْضِ وَ اَلنَّخْلِ وَ قَدْ قَبَّلَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ خَيْبَرَ وَ عَلَى اَلْمُتَقَبِّلِينَ سِوَى قَبَالَةِ اَلْأَرْضِ اَلْعُشْرُ وَنِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ فِي حِصَصِهِمْ« وَقَالَ» إِنَّ أَهْلَ اَلطَّائِفِ أَسْلَمُوا وَجَعَلُوا عَلَيْهِمُ اَلْعُشْرَ وَنِصْفَ اَلْعُشْرِ وَإِنَّ أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ لَمَّا دَخَلَهَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ص عَنْوَةً وَ كَانُوا أُسَرَاءَ فِي يَدِهِ فَأَعْتَقَهُمْ وَ قَالَ» اِذْهَبُوا فَأَنْتُمُ اَلطُّلَقَاءُ««.

items.e: As for what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated from his two brothers, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the zakat of land, when the Prophet (saws), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, or the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, leases it (qabbalaha) for half, or a third, or a quarter, then its zakat is upon him, And there is no zakat upon the one who accepts the lease (al-mutaqabbil), unless the owner of the land stipulates that the zakat is upon the one who accepts the lease. If he (the one who leases) stipulates it, then the zakat is upon them. And there is no zakat upon the people of the land today, except upon one in whose hand there is something from what the Messenger (saws), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, granted as a land allotment.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَخَوَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي زَكَاةِ اَلْأَرْضِ إِذَا قَبَّلَهَا اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَوِ اَلْإِمَامُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِالنِّصْفِ أَوِ اَلثُّلُثِ أَوِ اَلرُّبُعِ فَزَكَاتُهَا عَلَيْهِ وَلَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْمُتَقَبِّلِ زَكَاةٌ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ صَاحِبُ اَلْأَرْضِ أَنَّ اَلزَّكَاةَ عَلَى اَلْمُتَقَبِّلِ فَإِنِ اِشْتَرَطَ فَإِنَّ اَلزَّكَاةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى أَهْلِ اَلْأَرْضِ اَلْيَوْمَ زَكَاةٌ إِلاَّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ فِي يَدِهِ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا أَقْطَعَهُ اَلرَّسُولُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Jafar, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), recalling: “The companions of my father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) came to him and asked him about ‘what the ruler takes’, so he felt compassion for them, while he certainly knew that zakat is not lawful except for its people. So he (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) commanded them to count it as such, and by Allah (swt), that was valid for them.” So I (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) asked: “O my father, if they hear that, no one will pay zakat.” So Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “O son, it’s a truth that Allah (swt) loved to make manifest.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ أَبِي أَتَوْهُ فَسَأَلُوهُ عَمَّا يَأْخُذُهُ اَلسُّلْطَانُ فَرَقَّ لَهُمْ وَ إِنَّهُ لَيَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اَلزَّكَاةَ لاَ تَحِلُّ إِلاَّ لِأَهْلِهَا فَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَحْتَسِبُوا بِهِ فَجَازَ ذَا وَ اَللَّهِ لَهُمْ فَقُلْتُ أَيْ أَبَهْ إِنَّهُمْ إِنْ سَمِعُوا ذَلِكَ لَمْ يُزَكِّ أَحَدٌ فَقَالَ» أَيْ بُنَيَّ حَقٌّ أَحَبَّ اَللَّهُ أَنْ يُظْهِرَهُ««.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Tawil, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding zakat, whatever Banu Umayyah have taken from you, count it as such (zakat). And do not give them anything as much as you are able, for wealth cannot remain such that it is paid as zakat twice.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلطَّوِيلِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلزَّكَاةِ فَقَالَ» مَا أَخَذَهُ مِنْكُمْ بَنُو أُ مَيَّةَ فَاحْتَسِبُوا بِهِ وَ لاَ تُعْطُوهُمْ شَيْئاً مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ فَإِنَّ اَلْمَالَ لاَ يَبْقَى عَلَى هَذَا أَنْ يُزَكِّيَهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Abu Jafar, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the charity of wealth that the ruler takes.’ Imam (a.s) said: “I do not command you to repeat it.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَدَقَةِ اَلْمَالِ يَأْخُذُهَا اَلسُّلْطَانُ فَقَالَ» لاَ آمُرُكَ أَنْ تُعِيدَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim ibn Uthman, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Usamah, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be made your ransom, these collectors of charity (al-musaddiqin) come to us and take charity from us, so we give it to them; does it suffice on our behalf?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. These are only a people who have usurped from you,” or Imam (a.s) said: “They have wronged you regarding your wealth, and charity is only for its people.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ اَلْمُصَدِّقِينَ يَأْتُونَّا فَيَأْخُذُونَ مِنَّا اَلصَّدَقَةَ فَنُعْطِيهِمْ إِيَّاهَا أَ تُجْزِي عَنَّا فَقَالَ» لاَ إِنَّمَا هَؤُلاَءِ قَوْمٌ غَصَبُوكُمْ« أَوْ قَالَ» ظَلَمُوكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ وَ إِنَّمَا اَلصَّدَقَةُ لِأَهْلِهَا«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Any man who has cultivation or fruit, and he gives its charity, then there is nothing upon him in it if a year passes over it while it is with him, unless he converts it into wealth. If he does so, and a year passes over it while it is with him, then he must pay zakat on it, otherwise there is nothing upon him, even if it remains for a thousand years, so long as it is itself. Rather, upon him is the charity of the tithe. So when he has paid it once, there is nothing upon him until it is converted into wealth and a year passes over it while it is with him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع قَالَ:» أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ كَانَ لَهُ حَرْثٌ أَوْ ثَمَرَةٌ فَصَدَّقَهَا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهِ شَيْ ءٌإِنْ حَالَ عَلَيْهَا اَلْحَوْلُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُحَوِّلَهُ مَالاً وَ إِنْ فَعَلَ فَحَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ عِنْدَهُ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُزَكِّيَهُ وَ إِلاَّ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَوْ ثَبَتَ أَلْفَ عَامٍ إِذَا كَانَ بِعَيْنِهِ وَ إِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةُ اَلْعُشْرِ فَإِذَا أَدَّاهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَوَّلَ مَالاً وَ يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa al-Juhani, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from Zurarah ibn Ayan, Muhammad ibn Muslim, Abu Basir, Burayd al-Ijli, and al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon working camels and cattle. Charities are only upon grazing, pasturing livestock. And everything over which a year has not passed while it is with its owner, then there is nothing upon him in it. But when a year has passed over it, it becomes obligatory upon him.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى اَلْجُهَنِيِّ عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ بُرَيْدٍ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْعَوَامِلِ مِنَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ شَيْ ءٌإِنَّمَا اَلصَّدَقَاتُ عَلَى اَلسَّائِمَةِ اَلرَّاعِيَةِ وَ كُلُّ مَا لَمْ يَحُلْ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ فَلاَ شَيْءَ فِيهِ عَلَيْهِ فَإِذَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Harun ibn Muslim, from al-Qasim ibn Urwah, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat in anything of animals other than these three categories: camels, cattle, and sheep. And everything from these categories, from domesticated animals and working animals, there is nothing in them until a year passes over them from the day they are born.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلْحَيَوَانِ زَكَاةٌ غَيْرِ هَذِهِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ اَلثَّلاَثَةِ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ وَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ مِنَ اَلدَّوَاجِنِ وَ اَلْعَوَامِلِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ مُنْذُ يَوْمِ يُنْتَجُ«.

items.e: As for what Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said: I asked him about ‘camels belonging to a camel-driver, and which are in some of the towns. Does zakat apply to them as it applies to grazing livestock in the wilderness?’ He said: “Yes.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْإِبِلِ تَكُونُ لِلْجَمَّالِ وَ تَكُونُ فِي بَعْضِ اَلْأَمْصَارِ أَ تَجْرِي عَلَيْهَا اَلزَّكَاةُ كَمَا تَجْرِي عَلَى اَلسَّائِمَةِ فِي اَلْبَرِّيَّةِ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ«.

items.e: And Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Ishaq: I (narrator) asked Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘working camels, Is there zakat upon them?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, there is zakat upon them.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْإِبِلِ اَلْعَوَامِلِ عَلَيْهَا زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ عَلَيْهَا زَكَاةٌ«.

items.e: And Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abdullah ibn Bahr, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘camels belonging to a camel-driver (jammal), or which are in some of the towns. Does zakat apply to them as it applies to grazing livestock in the wilderness?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: وَرَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بَحْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْإِبِلِ تَكُونُ لِلْجَمَّالِ أَوْ تَكُونُ فِي بَعْضِ اَلْأَمْصَارِ أَ تَجْرِي عَلَيْهَا اَلزَّكَاةُ كَمَا تَجْرِي عَلَى اَلسَّائِمَةِ فِي اَلْبَرِّيَّةِ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from some of his companions, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing in the young of camels, cattle, and sheep except that over which a year has passed while it is with the man, and there is nothing in their offspring until a year passes over it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ فِي صِغَارِ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ شَيْءٌ إِلاَّ مَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ عِنْدَ اَلرَّجُلِ وَ لَيْسَ فِي أَوْلاَدِهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Suhban, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Muhammad ibn Samaah, from a man, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Nothing is paid as zakat from camels, cattle, and sheep except that over which a year has passed. And whatever a year has not passed over is as though it did not exist.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلصُّهْبَانِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ يُزَكَّى مِنَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ إِلاَّ مَا حَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَ مَا لَمْ يَحُلْ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ فَكَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man has wealth with him; does he pay zakat on it when half the year has passed?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, but rather until a year passes over it and it becomes due upon him. No one may perform a prayer except at its time, and likewise zakat. And no one fasts the month of Ramadan except in its month, except as a make-up, and every obligation is only performed when it becomes due.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ اَلْمَالُ أَ يُزَكِّيهِ إِذَا مَضَى نِصْفُ اَلسَّنَةِ قَالَ» لاَ وَ لَكِنْ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَوْلُ وَ تَحِلَّ عَلَيْهِ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ صَلاَةً إِلاَّ لِوَقْتِهَا وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَ لاَ يَصُومُ أَحَدٌ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ إِلاَّ فِي شَهْرِهِ إِلاَّ قَضَاءً وَ كُلُّ فَرِيضَةٍ إِنَّمَا تُؤَدَّى إِذَا حَلَّتْ«.
items.h: Chapter on Hastening Zakat and Delaying It Beyond the Times in Which It Becomes Obligatory

items.e: Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “Does a man pay zakat on his wealth when one third of the year has passed?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. Do you perform the first prayer before midday?”
items.o: حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ يُزَكِّي اَلرَّجُلُ مَالَهُ إِذَا مَضَى ثُلُثُ اَلسَّنَةِ قَالَ» لاَ أَ تُصَلِّي اَلْأُولَى قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “A man upon whom zakat becomes due in the month of Ramadan, so he delays it until Muharram.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘But it does not become due except in Muharram, so he hastens it in the month of Ramadan.’” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ تَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيُؤَخِّرُهَا إِلَى اَلْمُحَرَّمِ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهَا لاَ تَحِلُّ إِلاَّ فِي اَلْمُحَرَّمِ فَيُعَجِّلُهَا فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man to whom a needy person comes, so he gives him from his zakat at the beginning of the year.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he is needy, then there is no harm.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْتِيهِ اَلْمُحْتَاجُ فَيُعْطِيهِ مِنْ زَكَاتِهِ فِي أَوَّلِ اَلسَّنَةِ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ مُحْتَاجاً فَلاَ بَأْسَ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in hastening zakat by two months and delaying it by two months.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ بَأْسَ بِتَعْجِيلِ اَلزَّكَاةِ شَهْرَيْنِ وَ تَأْخِيرِهَا شَهْرَيْنِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from some of our companions, from Abu Said al-Mukari, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who hastens his zakat before the due time.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When eight months have passed, then there is no harm.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ اَلْمُكَارِي عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُعَجِّلُ زَكَاتَهُ قَبْلَ اَلْمَحِلِّ فَقَالَ» إِذَا مَضَتْ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَشْهُرٍ فَلاَ بَأْسَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Ahwal: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who hastened the zakat of his wealth, then the one who was given became well-off before the beginning of the year.’ Imam (a.s) said: “The giver repeats the zakat.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْأَحْوَلِ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَجَّلَ زَكَاةَ مَالِهِ ثُمَّ أَيْسَرَ اَلْمُعْطَى قَبْلَ رَأْسِ اَلسَّنَةِ قَالَ» يُعِيدُ اَلْمُعْطِي اَلزَّكَاةَ«.

items.e: And Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated this narration from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Ahwal: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (narrated) the like of the first (hadith.117).
items.o: وَ رَوَى هَذَا اَلْحَدِيثَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اَلْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَ اَلْأَوَّلِ.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) was asked regarding ‘a man who takes out his zakat, then distributes part of it, while some remains, seeking the proper places for it, and there is between its beginning and its end three months.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُخْرِجُ زَكَاتَهُ فَيَقْسِمُ بَعْضَهَا وَ يَبْقَى بَعْضٌ يَلْتَمِسُ لَهَا اَلْمَوَاضِعَ فَيَكُونُ بَيْنَ أَوَّلِهِ وَ آخِرِهِ ثَلاَثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Abu Jafar, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Yunus ibn Yaqub, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “My zakat becomes due upon me for a month; is it proper for me to withhold something from it, fearing that someone who asks me may come to me, so that it may be a reserve with me?” Imam (a.s) said: “When the year has passed, then take it out from your wealth and do not mix it with anything, and give it however you wish.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then if I write it down and record it, is that valid for me?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, it will not harm you.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ زَكَاتِي تَحِلُّ عَلَيَّ شَهْراً فَيَصْلُحُ لِي أَنْ أَحْبِسَ مِنْهَا شَيْئاً مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَجِيئَنِي مَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي يَكُونُ عِنْدِي عُدَّةً فَقَالَ» إِذَا حَالَ اَلْحَوْلُ فَأَخْرِجْهَا مِنْ مَالِكَ وَ لاَ تَخْلِطْهَا بِشَيْءٍ وَ أَعْطِهَا كَيْفَ شِئْتَ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ أَنَا كَتَبْتُهَا وَ أَثْبَتُّهَا يَسْتَقِيمُ لِي قَالَ» نَعَمْ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from the one who informed him, from Durust ibn Abi Mansur, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said: (Imam (a.s) was asked) ‘regarding zakat, a man sends it to a town other than his own town’. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in sending a third or a quarter.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ دُرُسْتَ بْنِ أَبِي مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي اَلزَّكَاةِ يَبْعَثُ بِهَا اَلرَّجُلُ إِلَى بَلَدٍ غَيْرِ بَلَدِهِ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يَبْعَثَ بِالثُّلُثِ أَوِ اَلرُّبُعِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Yaqub ibn Shuayb al-Haddad, from the righteous servant (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “A man from among us is in an isolated land; what should he do with the zakat of his wealth?” Imam (a.s) said: “He places it among his brothers and the people of his wilayah.” So I (narrator) asked: “Then if none of them is present with him there?” Imam (a.s) said: “He sends it to them.” I asked: “Then if he does not find anyone to carry it to them?” Imam (a.s) said: “He gives it to one who does not show hostility (la yansib).” I asked: “Then others besides them?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing for others besides them except stone.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ اَلْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ اَلْحَدَّادِ عَنِ اَلْعَبْدِ اَلصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ مِنَّا يَكُونُ فِي أَرْضٍ مُنْقَطِعَةٍ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ بِزَكَاةِ مَالِهِ قَالَ» يَضَعُهَا فِي إِخْوَانِهِ وَ أَهْلِ وَلاَيَتِهِ« فَقُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَحْضُرْهُ مِنْهُمْ فِيهَا أَحَدٌ قَالَ» يَبْعَثُ بِهَا إِلَيْهِمْ« قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ مَنْ يَحْمِلُهَا إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ» يَدْفَعُهَا إِلَى مَنْ لاَ يَنْصِبُ« قُلْتُ فَغَيْرُهُمْ قَالَ» مَا لِغَيْرِهِمْ إِلاَّ اَلْحَجَرُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Abdullah ibn Jafar and others, from Ahmad ibn Hamzah, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), about ‘a man who takes his zakat out from one town to another town and spends it among his brothers. Is that permissible?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُخْرِجُ زَكَاتَهُ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلَى بَلَدٍ آخَرَ وَيَصْرِفُهَا فِي إِخْوَانِهِ فَهَلْ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Hariz, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “When a man takes zakat out from his wealth, then names it for a people, and it is lost, or sends it to them and it is lost, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا أَخْرَجَ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلزَّكَاةَ مِنْ مَالِهِ ثُمَّ سَمَّاهَا لِقَوْمٍ فَضَاعَتْ أَوْ أَرْسَلَ بِهَا إِلَيْهِمْ فَضَاعَتْ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Jamil ibn Salih, from Bukayr ibn Ayan, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who sends his zakat, and it is stolen or lost.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَبْعَثُ بِزَكَاتِهِ فَتُسْرَقُ أَوْ تَضِيعُ فَقَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man sent the zakat of his wealth so that it would be distributed, and it was lost; is he liable for it until it is distributed?” Imam (a.s) said: “If he finds a place for it and does not give it, then he is liable for it until he gives it. But if he does not find anyone to whom he can give it, and he sends it to its people, then there is no liability upon him, because it has gone out of his hand. And likewise, the executor who is appointed by will is liable for what is handed over to him if he finds its owner, the one whom he was commanded to hand it over to. But if he does not find him, then there is no liability upon him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ بَعَثَ بِزَكَاةِ مَالِهِ لِتُقْسَمَ فَضَاعَتْ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ ضَمَانُهَا حَتَّى تُقْسَمَ فَقَالَ» إِذَا وَجَدَ لَهَا مَوْضِعاً فَلَمْ يَدْفَعْهَا فَهُوَ لَهَا ضَامِنٌ حَتَّى يَدْفَعَهَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ لَهَا مَنْ يَدْفَعُهَا إِلَيْهِ فَبَعَثَ بِهَا إِلَى أَهْلِهَا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ ضَمَانٌ لِأَنَّهَا قَدْ خَرَجَتْ مِنْ يَدِهِ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْوَصِيُّ اَلَّذِي يُوصَى إِلَيْهِ يَكُونُ ضَامِناً لِمَا دُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ إِذَا وَجَدَ رَبَّهُ اَلَّذِي أُمِرَ بِدَفْعِهِ إِلَيْهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ ضَمَانٌ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man to whom a brother of his sent zakat so that he would distribute it, and it was lost.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no liability upon the messenger, nor upon the one who pays it.” So I (narrator) asked: “Then if he does not find people entitled to it, and it spoils and changes, is he liable for it?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. But if he knows people entitled to it, and it perishes or spoils, then he is liable for it from the time he delayed it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ بَعَثَ إِلَيْهِ أَخٌ لَهُ زَكَاةً لِيَقْسِمَهَا فَضَاعَتْ فَقَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلرَّسُولِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْمُؤَدِّي ضَمَانٌ« فَقُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ لَهَا أَهْلاً فَفَسَدَتْ وَ تَغَيَّرَتْ أَيَضْمَنُهَا قَالَ» لاَ وَ لَكِنْ إِنْ عَرَفَ لَهَا أَهْلاً فَعَطِبَتْ أَوْ فَسَدَتْ فَهُوَ لَهَا ضَامِنٌ مِنْ حِينَ أَخَّرَهَا«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Said, from Zurah, from Samaah: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘zakat, for whom is it proper to take it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is lawful for those whom Allah (swt), described in His Book: ‘(Alms-tax) is only for the poor and the needy, for those employed to administer it, for those whose hearts are to be attracted (to the faith), for (freeing) slaves, for those in debt, for Allah’s (swt) cause, and for (needy) travellers. (This is) an obligation from almighty Allah (swt).’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:60) And zakat may be lawful for the owner of seven hundred, and unlawful for the owner of fifty dirhams.” So I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “How can this be?” Imam (a.s) said: “If the owner of the seven hundred has many dependants, and if he were to divide it among them it would not suffice him, then let him restrain himself from it and let him take it for his dependants. As for the owner of the fifty, it is unlawful for him if he is alone and is a craftsman who works with it, and he obtains from it what suffices him, if Allah (swt) wills.” He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘zakat, Is it proper for the owner of a house and a servant?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, unless his house is a house of yield, and from its yield dirhams come out for him that suffice him for himself and his dependants. But if the yield is not enough for himself and his dependants in their food, their clothing, and their needs, without extravagance, then zakat has become lawful for him. But if its yield suffices them, then no.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ لِمَنْ يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَهَا قَالَ» هِيَ تَحِلُّ لِلَّذِينَ وَصَفَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي كِتَابِهِ» لِلْفُقَرٰاءِ وَ اَلْمَسٰاكِينِ وَاَلْعٰامِلِينَ عَلَيْهٰا وَ اَلْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَ فِي اَلرِّقٰابِ وَ اَلْغٰارِمِينَ وَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهَِ وَ اِبْنِ اَلسَّبِيلِ فَرِيضَةً مِنَ اللهَِ« وَ قَدْ تَحِلُّ اَلزَّكَاةُ لِصَاحِبِ سَبْعِمِائَةٍ وَتَحْرُمُ عَلَى صَاحِبِ خَمْسِينَ دِرْهَماً« فَقُلْتُ لَهُ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ هَذَا فَقَالَ» إِذَا كَانَ صَاحِبُ اَلسَّبْعِمِائَةِ لَهُ عِيَالٌ كَثِيرَةٌ فَلَوْ قَسَمَهَا بَيْنَهُمْ لَمْ تَكْفِهِ فَلْيُعِفَّ عَنْهَا نَفْسُهُ وَلْيَأْخُذْهَا لِعِيَالِهِ وَ أَمَّا صَاحِبُ اَلْخَمْسِينَ فَإِنَّهَا تَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ إِذَا كَانَ وَحْدَهُ وَ هُوَ مُحْتَرِفٌ يَعْمَلُ بِهَا وَ هُوَ يُصِيبُ فِيهَا مَا يَكْفِيهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ« قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ هَلْ تَصْلُحُ لِصَاحِبِ اَلدَّارِ وَ اَلْخَادِمِ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ دَارُهُ دَارَ غَلَّةٍ فَيَخْرُجُ لَهُ مِنْ غَلَّتِهَا دَرَاهِمُ تَكْفِيهِ لِنَفْسِهِ وَعِيَالِهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنِ اَلْغَلَّةُ تَكْفِيهِ لِنَفْسِهِ وَعِيَالِهِ فِي طَعَامِهِمْ وَكِسْوَتِهِمْ وَحَاجَتِهِمْ فِي غَيْرِ إِسْرَافٍ فَقَدْ حَلَّتْ لَهُ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ غَلَّتُهَا تَكْفِيهِمْ فَلاَ«.
items.h: Chapter on Categories of the People of Zakat

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim: They both (Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “Have you considered the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: ‘(Alms-tax) is only for the poor and the needy, for those employed to administer it, for those whose hearts are to be attracted (to the faith), for (freeing) slaves, for those in debt, for Allah’s (swt) cause, and for (needy) travellers. (This is) an obligation from almighty Allah (swt).’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:60) Are all of these given, even if he does not recognize?” Imam (a.s) said: “The Imam gives all of these, as they acknowledge obedience to him.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then if they do not recognize?’” Imam (a.s) said: “O Zurarah, if he were to give to the one who recognizes and not to the one who does not recognize, no place would be found for it. Rather, he gives to the one who does not recognize so that he may desire the religion and remain firm upon it. As for today, then neither you nor your companions should give it except to one who recognizes. So whoever you find among these Muslims as one who recognizes, give it to him rather than the people.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “The share of those whose hearts are to be reconciled and the share of freeing slaves are general, and the rest are specific.” He (narrator) said: “I said to Imam (a.s): ‘Then if they are not found?’” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no obligation that Allah (swt), the Exalted, has imposed except that people entitled to it are found.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then if the charities are not enough for them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Allah (swt) has obligated for the poor in the wealth of the rich that which suffices them. If Allah (swt) had known that this would not suffice them, Allah (swt) would have increased it for them. They have not been deprived because of the obligation of almighty Allah (swt), but they have been deprived because of the withholding of those who withheld their right from them, not because of what Allah (swt) obligated for them. If the people had paid their rights, they would have lived in goodness.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ: أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ رَأَيْتَ قَوْلَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» إِنَّمَا اَلصَّدَقٰاتُ لِلْفُقَرٰاءِ وَ اَلْمَسٰاكِينِ وَاَلْعٰامِلِينَ عَلَيْهٰا وَ اَلْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَ فِي اَلرِّقٰابِ وَ اَلْغٰارِمِينَ وَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهَِ وَ اِبْنِ اَلسَّبِيلِ فَرِيضَةً مِنَ اللهَِ« أَ كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ يُعْطَى وَ إِنْ كَانَ لاَ يَعْرِفُ فَقَالَ» إِنَّ اَلْإِمَامَ يُعْطِي هَؤُلاَءِ جَمِيعاً لِأَنَّهُمْ يُقِرُّونَ لَهُ بِالطَّاعَةِ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانُوا لاَ يَعْرِفُونَ فَقَالَ» يَا زُرَارَةُ لَوْ كَانَ يُعْطِي مَنْ يَعْرِفُ دُونَ مَنْ لاَ يَعْرِفُ لَمْ يُوجَدْ لَهَا مَوْضِعٌ وَإِنَّمَا يُعْطِي مَنْ لاَ يَعْرِفُ لِيَرْغَبَ فِي اَلدِّينِ فَيَثْبُتَ عَلَيْهِ فَأَمَّا اَلْيَوْمَ فَلاَ تُعْطِهَا أَنْتَ وَ أَصْحَابُكَ إِلاَّ مَنْ يَعْرِفُ فَمَنْ وَجَدْتَ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ عَارِفاً فَأَعْطِهِ دُونَ اَلنَّاسِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» سَهْمُ اَلْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَ سَهْمُ اَلرِّقَابِ عَامٌّ وَ اَلْبَاقِي خَاصُّ« قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُوجَدُوا قَالَ» لاَ يَكُونُ فَرِيضَةٌ فَرَضَهَا اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى إِلاَّ أَنْ يُوجَدَ لَهَا أَهْلٌ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَسَعْهُمُ اَلصَّدَقَاتُ فَقَالَ» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ فَرَضَ لِلْفُقَرَاءِ فِي مَالِ اَلْأَغْنِيَاءِ مَا يَسَعُهُمْ وَ لَوْ عَلِمَ اَللَّهُ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يَسَعُهُمْ لَزَادَهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ لَمْ يُؤْتَوْا مِنْ قِبَلِ فَرِيضَةِ اَللَّهِ وَ لَكِنْ أُوتُوا مِنْ مَنْعِ مَنْ مَنَعَهُمْ حَقَّهُمْ لاَ مِمَّا فَرَضَ اَللَّهُ لَهُمْ وَ لَوْ أَنَّ اَلنَّاسَ أَدَّوْا حُقُوقَهُمْ لَكَانُوا عَائِشِينَ بِخَيْرٍ«.

items.e: And Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim mentioned in the Book of Tafsir the detailed explanation of these eight categories, and he (Ali ibn Ibrahim) said: The Scholar, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s), peace be upon him, explained them and said: (First category) “‘The poor’ are those who do not ask, because of the saying of almighty Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, in Surah al-Baqarah (and Surah At-Tawbah 9:60): ‘(Charity is) for the needy who are too engaged in the cause of Allah (swt) to move about in the land (for work). Those unfamiliar with their situation will think they are not in need (of charity) because they do not beg. You can recognize them by their appearance. They do not beg people persistently. Whatever you give in charity is certainly well known to Allah (swt).’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:273) (Second category) “And ‘the needy’ are the people of religions; men, women, and children have entered into them.” (Third category) “And ‘those who work over it’ are the collectors and gatherers in taking it, collecting it, and preserving it until they deliver it to the one who distributes it.” (Fourth category) “And ‘those whose hearts are to be reconciled,’ they are a people who professed the oneness of Allah (swt) and cast off the worship of those besides the almighty Allah (swt), but the recognition had not entered their hearts that Prophet Muhammad (saws) is the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. So the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to reconcile them, teach them, and make them recognize, so that they might recognize. Thus He (saws) assigned for them a share in the charities so that they might recognize and become inclined.” (Fifth category) “And ‘in the necks’ refers to a people upon whom expiations have become obligatory in accidental killing, in zihar, in oaths, and in killing game within the sanctuary, and they do not have that with which they may expiate, while they are believers. So Allah (swt) assigned for them a share in the charities so that expiation may be made on their behalf.” (Sixth category) “And ‘the debtors’ are a people upon whom debts have fallen, which they spent in obedience to Allah (swt) without extravagance. Thus it is obligatory upon the Imam to pay on their behalf and release them from the wealth of the charities.” (Seventh category) “And ‘in the way of Allah (swt)’ refers to a people who go out for jihad and do not have that by which they may gain strength, or a people from among the believers who do not have that by which they may perform Hajj, or in all paths of good. Therefore, it is upon the Imam to give them from the wealth of the charities until they become able for Hajj and jihad.” (Eight category) “And ‘the son of the way’ refers to the needy travellers of the road (wayfarers), those who are in journeys in obedience to Allah (swt), then they are cut off and their wealth is lost. Therefore, it is upon the Imam to return them to their homelands from the wealth of the charities.”
items.o: وَ ذَكَرَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ فِي كِتَابِ اَلتَّفْسِيرِ تَفْصِيلَ هَذِهِ اَلثَّمَانِيَةِ اَلْأَصْنَافِ فَقَالَ فَسَّرَهُمُ اَلْعَالِمُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ:» اَلْفُقَرَاءُ هُمُ اَلَّذِينَ لاَ يَسْأَلُونَ لِقَوْلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي سُورَةِ اَلْبَقَرَةِ» لِلْفُقَرٰاءِ اَلَّذِينَ أُحْصِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللهَِ لاٰ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ضَرْباً فِي اَلْأَرْضِ يَحْسَبُهُمُ اَلْجٰاهِلُ أَغْنِيٰاءَ مِنَ اَلتَّعَفُّفِ تَعْرِفُهُمْ بِسِيمٰاهُمْ لاٰ يَسْئَلُونَ اَلنّٰاسَ إِلْحٰافاً« وَ اَلْمَسَاكِينُ هُمْ أَهْلُ اَلدِّيَانَاتِ قَدْ دَخَلَ فِيهِمُ اَلرِّجَالُ وَ اَلنِّسَاءُ وَ اَلصِّبْيَانُ» وَاَلْعٰامِلِينَ عَلَيْهٰا« هُمُ اَلسُّعَاةُ وَاَلْجُبَاةُ فِي أَخْذِهَا وَجَمْعِهَا وَحِفْظِهَا حَتَّى يُؤَدُّوهَا إِلَى مَنْ يَقْسِمُهَا وَاَلْمُؤَلَّفَةُ» قُلُوبُهُمْ«« قَالَ» هُمْ قَوْمٌ وَحَّدُوا اَللَّهَ وَخَلَعُوا عِبَادَةَ مَنْ دُونَ اَللَّهِ وَ لَمْ تَدْخُلِ اَلْمَعْرِفَةُ قُلُوبَهُمْ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ يَتَأَلَّفُهُمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمْ وَيُعَرِّفُهُمْ كَيْمَا يَعْرِفُوا فَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ نَصِيباً فِي اَلصَّدَقَاتِ لِكَيْ يَعْرِفُوا وَيَرْغَبُوا» وَفِي اَلرِّقٰابِ« قَوْمٌ لَزِمَتْهُمْ كَفَّارَاتٌ فِي قَتْلِ اَلْخَطَإِ وَفِي اَلظِّهَارِ وَفِي اَلْأَيْمَانِ وَفِي قَتْلِ اَلصَّيْدِ فِي اَلْحَرَمِ وَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُمْ مَا يُكَفِّرُونَ وَ هُمْ مُؤْمِنُونَ فَجَعَلَ اَللَّهُ لَهُمْ سَهْماً فِي اَلصَّدَقَاتِ لِيُكَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ» وَ اَلْغٰارِمِينَ« قَوْمٌ قَدْ وَقَعَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ دُيُونٌ أَنْفَقُوهَا فِي طَاعَةِ اَللَّهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ إِسْرَافٍ فَيَجِبُ عَلَى اَلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْهُمْ وَ يَفُكَّهُمْ مِنْ مَالِ اَلصَّدَقَاتِ »وَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهَِ« قَوْمٌ يَخْرُجُونَ فِي اَلْجِهَادِ وَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُمْ مَا يَتَقَوَّوْنَ بِهِ أَوْ قَوْمٌ مِنَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُمْ مَا يَحُجُّونَ بِهِ أَوْ فِي جَمِيعِ سُبُلِ اَلْخَيْرِ فَعَلَى اَلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُمْ مِنْ مَالِ اَلصَّدَقَاتِ حَتَّى يَقْوَوْا عَلَى اَلْحَجِّ وَ اَلْجِهَادِ وَ اِبْنُ» اَلسَّبِيلِ« أَبْنَاءُ اَلطَّرِيقِ اَلَّذِينَ يَكُونُونَ فِي اَلْأَسْفَارِ فِي طَاعَةِ اَللَّهِ فَيُقْطَعُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ يَذْهَبُ مَالُهُمْ فَعَلَى اَلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَرُدَّهُمْ إِلَى أَوْطَانِهِمْ مِنْ مَالِ اَلصَّدَقَاتِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Yazid ibn Ishaq, from Harun ibn Hamzah, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “It has been narrated from the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, that He (saws) said: ‘Charity is not lawful for a rich person, nor for one possessing strength and soundness.’” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not proper for a rich person.” He (narrator) said: “Then I said to Imam (a.s): ‘A man has three hundred dirhams in merchandise, and he has dependents. If he turns to it, his dependents would consume it, and they would not be sufficed by its profit.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then he should look at what surplus he obtains from it, and he should eat from it, he and whoever among them that suffices; and he should take for those among his dependents whom it does not suffice.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رُوِيَ عَنِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ» لاَ تَحِلُّ اَلصَّدَقَةُ لِغَنِيٍّ وَلاَ لِذِي مِرَّةٍ سَوِيٍّ« فَقَالَ» لاَ تَصْلُحُ لِغَنِيٍّ« قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ لَهُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ فِي بِضَاعَةٍ وَ لَهُ عِيَالٌ فَإِنْ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهَا أَكَلَهَا عِيَالُهُ وَ لَمْ يَكْتَفُوا بِرِبْحِهَا قَالَ» فَلْيَنْظُرْ مَا يَسْتَفْضِلُ مِنْهَا فَيَأْكُلَهُ هُوَ وَ مَنْ يَسَعُهُ ذَلِكَ وَ لْيَأْخُذْ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَسَعْهُ مِنْ عِيَالِهِ«.
items.h: Chapter on One Entitled to Zakat Due to Poverty and Destitution from Among the Categories

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Ibn Muslim. Zurarah said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “If there is more than one in the city?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then give to all of them, if you are able.” He (narrator) said: “Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘It is not lawful for one who has forty dirhams with him, upon which a year passes while they are with him, to take it; and if he takes it, he has taken it unlawfully.’”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ اِبْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ زُرَارَةُ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَإِنْ كَانَ بِالْمِصْرِ غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ قَالَ» فَأَعْطِهِمْ إِنْ قَدَرْتَ جَمِيعاً« قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ» لاَ تَحِلُّ لِمَنْ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ أَرْبَعُونَ دِرْهَماً يَحُولُ عَلَيْهَا اَلْحَوْلُ عِنْدَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَهَا وَ إِنْ أَخَذَهَا أَخَذَهَا حَرَاماً«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from the one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘a man who gives the zakat of his wealth to a man while he thinks that he is in difficulty, then he finds him to be well-off.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It does not suffice on his behalf.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ يُعْطِي زَكَاةَ مَالِهِ رَجُلاً وَ هُوَ يَرَى أَنَّهُ مُعْسِرٌ فَوَجَدَهُ مُوسِراً قَالَ» لاَ يُجْزِي عَنْهُ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa al-Juhani, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from more than one person, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: The Imams (a.s) were asked about ‘a man who has a house, a servant, and a slave. May he accept zakat?’ They both (a.s) said: “Yes, indeed the house and the servant are not property.”
