items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى اَلْجُهَنِيِّ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُمَا سُئِلاَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ لَهُ دَارٌ وَخَادِمٌ وَعَبْدٌ يَقْبَلُ اَلزَّكَاةَ فَقَالاَ» نَعَمْ إِنَّ اَلدَّارَ وَاَلْخَادِمَ لَيْسَا بِمِلْكٍ«.

items.e: And from him, from Yahya ibn Isa, from Said ibn Yasar, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Zakat is lawful for the owner of a house and a servant,” Because Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, did not regard the house and the servant as anything (that eliminates the receiver from Zakat).
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» تَحِلُّ اَلزَّكَاةُ لِصَاحِبِ اَلدَّارِ وَ اَلْخَادِمِ« لِأَنَّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَى اَلدَّارَ وَ اَلْخَادِمَ شَيْئاً.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is for the people of wilayah; Allah (swt) has clarified for you its place in His (azj) Book.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَاِبْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ:» اَلزَّكَاةُ لِأَهْلِ اَلْوَلاَيَةِ قَدْ بَيَّنَ اَللَّهُ لَكُمْ مَوْضِعَهَا فِي كِتَابِهِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from al-Walid ibn Sabih, who said: Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih said to me: “Convey my greetings of peace to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and inform him that fright befalls me in my sleep.” He (narrator) said: “So I said to Imam (a.s): “Shihab conveys greetings of peace to you and says: ‘Fright befalls me in my sleep.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Say to Shihab: ‘Let him give zakat on his wealth.’” He (narrator) said: “So I conveyed that to Shihab, and Shihab said to me, ‘Will you convey from me to him?’” So I (narrator) said: “Yes.” He (Shihab) said: “Say to Imam (a.s) that indeed, children, let alone men, know that I give zakat.’” He (narrator) said: “So I conveyed it to Imam (a.s), and Abu Abdillah (a.s), said: ‘Say to Shihab; Indeed, you take it out, but you do not place it in its proper places.’”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ بْنِ صَبِيحٍ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ أَقْرِئْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِّي اَلسَّلاَمَ وَ أَعْلِمْهُ أَنَّهُ يُصِيبُنِي فَزَعٌ فِي مَنَامِي قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ شِهَاباً يُقْرِئُكَ اَلسَّلاَمَ وَ يَقُولُ إِنَّهُ يُصِيبُنِي فَزَعٌ فِي مَنَامِي قَالَ» قُلْ لَهُ فَلْيُزَكِّ مَالَهُ« قَالَ فَأَبْلَغْتُ شِهَاباً ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لِي فَتُبْلِغُهُ عَنِّي فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَقَالَ قُلْ لَهُ إِنَّ اَلصِّبْيَانَ فَضْلاً عَنِ اَلرِّجَالِ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أُزَكِّي قَالَ فَأَبْلَغْتُهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» قُلْ لَهُ إِنَّكَ تُخْرِجُهَا وَ لاَ تَضَعُهَا مَوَاضِعَهَا«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ismail ibn Sad al-Ashari, from Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘zakat, Is it to be placed among one who does not recognize?’ – meaning wilayah. Imam (a.s) said: “No, nor the zakat of al-fitrah.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلزَّكَاةِ هَلْ تُوضَعُ فِيمَنْ لاَ يَعْرِفُ قَالَ» لاَ وَ لاَ زَكَاةُ اَلْفِطْرَةِ«.

items.e: And Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Dawud al-Sarmi, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who drinks wine, Is he given anything from zakat?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ دَاوُدَ اَلصَّرْمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ شَارِبِ اَلْخَمْرِ يُعْطَى مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ شَيْئاً قَالَ» لاَ«.

items.e: Sad, from some of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Jumhur, from Ibrahim al-Awsi, from Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said that I heard my father (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)) saying: “I was with my father (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) one day, when a man came to him and said: ‘I am a man from the people of al-Rayy, and I have zakat, so to whom should I pay it?’ He (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) said: “To us.” So the man asked: “Is charity not forbidden for you?” He (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) said: “Yes. When you pay it to our Shia, then you have paid it to us.” So the man asked: “I do not know anyone for it.” He (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) said: “Wait with it for one year.” The man said: “If I do not find anyone for it?” He (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) said: “Wait with it for two years,” until Imam (a.s) reached four years. Then he (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) said to the man: “If you do not find anyone for it, then tie it into bundles and throw it into the sea, for Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden our wealth and the wealth of our Shia to our enemy.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُمْهُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلْأَوْسِيِّ عَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ: »كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي يَوْماً فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلرَّيِّ وَ لِي زَكَاةٌ فَإِلَى مَنْ أَدْفَعُهَا قَالَ» إِلَيْنَا« فَقَالَ أَلَيْسَ اَلصَّدَقَةُ مُحَرَّمَةً عَلَيْكُمْ فَقَالَ» بَلَى إِذَا دَفَعْتَهَا إِلَى شِيعَتِنَا فَقَدْ دَفَعْتَهَا إِلَيْنَا« فَقَالَ إِنِّي لاَ أَعْرِفُ لَهَا أَحَداً فَقَالَ »اِنْتَظِرْ بِهَا إِلَى سَنَةٍ« قَالَ فَإِنْ لَمْ أُصِبْ لَهَا أَحَداً قَالَ» اِنْتَظِرْ بِهَا إِلَى سَنَتَيْنِ حَتَّى بَلَغَ أَرْبَعَ سِنِينَ« ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ» إِنْ لَمْ تُصِبْ لَهَا أَحَداً فَصُرَّهَا صِرَاراً وَاِطْرَحْهَا فِي اَلْبَحْرِ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَرَّمَ أَمْوَالَنَا وَ أَمْوَالَ شِيعَتِنَا عَلَى عَدُوِّنَا««.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Bilal, who said: I (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s) asking: “Is it permissible for me to pay the zakat of wealth and charity to a needy person who is not from my companions?” Imam (a.s) wrote: “Do not give charity and zakat except to your companions.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ أَسْأَلُهُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ أَنْ أَدْفَعَ زَكَاةَ اَلْمَالِ وَ اَلصَّدَقَةَ إِلَى مُحْتَاجٍ غَيْرِ أَصْحَابِي فَكَتَبَ» لاَ تُعْطِ اَلصَّدَقَةَ وَ اَلزَّكَاةَ إِلاَّ لِأَصْحَابِكَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Umar, from Muhammad ibn Udhafir, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘charity upon the Nussab (Nawasib) and upon the Zaydiyyah.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Do not give charity to them with anything, and do not give them water to drink, if you are able.” And Imam (a.s) said: “The Zaydiyyah are the Nussab.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّدَقَةِ عَلَى اَلنُّصَّابِ وَ عَلَى اَلزَّيْدِيَّةِ قَالَ» لاَ تَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْهِمْ بِشَيْءٍ وَ لاَ تَسْقِهِمْ مِنَ اَلْمَاءِ إِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ« وَ قَالَ» اَلزَّيْدِيَّةُ هُمُ اَلنُّصَّابُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abdullah ibn Abi Yafur, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be made your ransom, what do you say ‘concerning zakat, for whom is it?’” Imam (a.s) said: “It is for your companions.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then if there is surplus beyond them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then return it to them.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then if there is surplus beyond them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then return it to them.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then if there is surplus beyond them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then return it to them.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then is anything from it given to beggars?’” He (narrator) said, so Imam (a.s) said: “No, by Allah (swt), except dust, unless you have mercy on him. So if you have mercy on him, then give him a fragment.” Then Imam (a.s) gestured with his hand and placed his thumb upon the roots of his fingers.
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ مَا تَقُولُ فِي اَلزَّكَاةِ لِمَنْ هِيَ قَالَ فَقَالَ» هِيَ لِأَصْحَابِكَ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ فَضَلَ عَنْهُمْ فَقَالَ »فَأَعِدْ عَلَيْهِمْ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ فَضَلَ عَنْهُمْ قَالَ» فَأَعِدْ عَلَيْهِمْ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ فَضَلَ عَنْهُمْ قَالَ» فَأَعِدْ عَلَيْهِمْ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَيُعْطَى اَلسُّؤَّالُ مِنْهَا شَيْئاً قَالَ فَقَالَ» لاَ وَ اَللَّهِ إِلاَّ اَلتُّرَابَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَرْحَمَهُ فَإِنْ رَحِمْتَهُ فَأَعْطِهِ كِسْرَةً« ثُمَّ أَوْمَى بِيَدِهِ فَوَضَعَ إِبْهَامَهُ عَلَى أُصُولِ أَصَابِعِهِ.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, Bukayr, al-Fudayl, Muhammad ibn Muslim, and Burayd al-Ijli, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said: (Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘a man who is upon some of these doctrines: the Haruriyyah (Kharijites), the Murjiah (Murji'ites), the Uthmaniyyah (adherents to Uthman), and the Qadariyyah (Sufi inclied tariqa), then he repents, recognizes this matter, and his view becomes good. Thus, must he repeat every prayer he prayed, or fast, or zakat, or Hajj, or is there no repetition of any of that upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no repetition of anything from that upon him except zakat, and he must certainly pay it, because he placed zakat in other than its proper place, and its proper place is only the people of wilayah.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ بُكَيْرٍ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ بُرَيْدٍ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي بَعْضِ هَذِهِ اَلْأَهْوَاءِ اَلْحَرُورِيَّةِ وَ اَلْمُرْجِئَةِ وَاَلْعُثْمَانِيَّةِ وَاَلْقَدَرِيَّةِ ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ وَ يَعْرِفُ هَذَا اَلْأَمْرَ وَ يَحْسُنُ رَأْيُهُ أَ يُعِيدُ كُلَّ صَلاَةٍ صَلاَّهَا أَوْ صَوْمٍ أَوْ زَكَاةٍ أَوْ حَجٍّ أَوْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةُ شَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةُ شَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ غَيْرِ اَلزَّكَاةِ وَ لاَ بُدَّ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَهَا لِأَنَّهُ وَضَعَ اَلزَّكَاةَ فِي غَيْرِ مَوْضِعِهَا وَإِنَّمَا مَوْضِعُهَا أَهْلُ اَلْوَلاَيَةِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Abdullah ibn Jafar, from Ahmad ibn Hamzah, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man from among your mawali has relatives, all of whom profess belief in you (wilayah), and he has zakat. Is it permissible for him to give them all of his zakat?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ مَوَالِيكَ لَهُ قَرَابَةٌ كُلُّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ بِكَ وَ لَهُ زَكَاةٌ أَ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُمْ جَمِيعَ زَكَاتِهِ قَالَ» نَعَمْ«.
items.h: Chapter on Relatives for Whom Zakat Is Lawful and for Whom It Is Unlawful

items.e: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who places all of his zakat among the people of his household, while they have wilayah toward you (the Imams (a.s)).’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَضَعُ زَكَاتَهُ كُلَّهَا فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ هُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَكَ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muthanna, from Abu Basir, who said: A man asked Imam (a.s) while I was listening, and he asked: “May I give my relatives from the zakat of my wealth, while they do not recognize you?” – meaning wilayah. He (narrator) said, so Imam (a.s) said: “Do not give zakat except to a Muslim, and give them from other than that.” Then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Do you think that there is nothing due in wealth except zakat alone? What Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has made obligatory in wealth besides zakat is greater than what you give from it to relatives and to those who come before you from among those who ask you, so you give to them, so long as you do not know them to be upon hostility (nasb/nawasib). But when you know him to be upon hostility (nasb), then do not give him, unless you fear his tongue, so you purchase your religion and your honor from him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ مُثَنًّى عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَقَالَ أُعْطِي قَرَابَتِي مِنْ زَكَاةِ مَالِي وَ هُمْ لاَ يَعْرِفُونَكَ قَالَ فَقَالَ» لاَ تُعْطِ اَلزَّكَاةَ إِلاَّ مُسْلِماً وَأَعْطِهِمْ مِنْ غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ« ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» أَتَرَوْنَ إِنَّمَا فِي اَلْمَالِ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَحْدَهَا مَا فَرَضَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي اَلْمَالِ مِنْ غَيْرِ اَلزَّكَاةِ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا تُعْطِي مِنْهُ اَلْقَرَابَةَ وَاَلْمُعْتَرِضَ لَكَ مِمَّنْ يَسْأَلُكَ فَتُعْطِيهِ مَا لَمْ تَعْرِفْهُ بِالنَّصْبِ فَإِذَا عَرَفْتَهُ بِالنَّصْبِ فَلاَ تُعْطِهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَخَافَ لِسَانَهُ فَتَشْتَرِيَ دِينَكَ وَعِرْضَكَ مِنْهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who has relatives, mawali, and orphans who love the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, but do not recognize the master of this matter (rightful Imam of the time). Are they to be given from zakat?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ لَهُ قَرَابَةٌ وَمَوَالٍ وَأَيْتَامٌ يُحِبُّونَ أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ لَيْسَ يَعْرِفُونَ صَاحِبَ هَذَا اَلْأَمْرِ أَ يُعْطَوْنَ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ قَالَ» لاَ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zurah, from Samaah, and Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu Basir, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man has zakat due upon him, and he has needy relatives who are not recognizers (of wilayah). Should he give them from zakat?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, and no honor. He must not make zakat a protection for his wealth. He may give them from other than zakat, if he wishes.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ اَلزَّكَاةُ وَ لَهُ قَرَابَةٌ مُحْتَاجُونَ غَيْرُ عَارِفِينَ أَ يُعْطِيهِمْ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَقَالَ» لاَ وَ لاَ كَرَامَةَ لاَ يَجْعَلُ اَلزَّكَاةَ وِقَايَةً لِمَالِهِ يُعْطِيهِمْ مِنْ غَيْرِ اَلزَّكَاةِ إِنْ أَرَادَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu al-Hasan Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “I have relatives and I spend on some of them and prefer some of them over others. Then the time of zakat comes to me, may I give them from it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Are they entitled to it?” I (narrator) replied: “Yes.” Imam (a.s) said: “They are better than others (non-relatives); give them.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘Then who is it among my relatives whose maintenance is binding upon me, so that I may not count zakat upon him?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Your father and your mother.” I (narrator) asked: “My father and my mother?” Imam (a.s) said: “The parents and the child.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ لِي قَرَابَةٌ أُنْفِقُ عَلَى بَعْضِهِمْ وَ أُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَيَأْتِينِي إِبَّانُ اَلزَّكَاةِ أَفَأُعْطِيهِمْ مِنْهَا قَالَ» أَمُسْتَحِقُّونَ لَهَا« قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ» هُمْ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ أَعْطِهِمْ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَنِ اَلَّذِي يَلْزَمُنِي مِنْ ذَوِي قَرَابَتِي حَتَّى لاَ أَحْتَسِبَ اَلزَّكَاةَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ» أَبُوكَ وَ أُمُّكَ« قُلْتُ أَبِي وَ أُمِّي قَالَ» اَلْوَالِدَانِ وَاَلْوُلْدُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu Abdullah, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Five are not to be given anything from zakat; the father, the mother, the child, the owned slave, and the wife. And that is because they are his dependents, bound to him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ:» خَمْسَةٌ لاَ يُعْطَوْنَ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ شَيْئاً اَلْأَبُ وَاَلْأُمُّ وَاَلْوَلَدُ وَاَلْمَمْلُوكُ وَاَلْمَرْأَةُ وَ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُمْ عِيَالُهُ لاَزِمُونَ لَهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Idris and others, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abu Jamilah, from Zayd al-Shahham, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “In zakat; the brother, the sister, the paternal uncle, the paternal aunt, the maternal uncle, and the maternal aunt are given from it. But the grandfather is not given, nor the grandmother.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ وَغَيْرِهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ زَيْدٍ اَلشَّحَّامِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي اَلزَّكَاةِ يُعْطَى مِنْهَا اَلْأَخُ وَ اَلْأُخْتُ وَاَلْعَمُّ وَاَلْعَمَّةُ وَاَلْخَالُ وَاَلْخَالَةُ وَ لاَ يُعْطَى اَلْجَدُّ وَ لاَ اَلْجَدَّةُ«.

items.e: As for what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Imran ibn Ismail ibn Imran al-Qummi, who said: I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him: “I have children, men and women; is it permissible for me to give them from zakat?” Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “That is permissible for you.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ اَلْقُمِّيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ لِي وُلْداً رِجَالاً وَ نِسَاءً أَفَيَجُوزُ أَنْ أُعْطِيَهُمْ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» أَنَّ ذَلِكَ جَائِزٌ لَكَ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Abu Khadijah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Do not give from zakat to anyone whom you maintain.” And he (narrator) asked: “If a man has five hundred dirhams and his dependents are many.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no zakat upon him; he spends it on his dependents, increasing it in their maintenance, in their clothing, and in food which they had not been eating. And if he does not have dependents and is alone, then let him distribute it among people in whom there is no harm, chaste from asking, who do not ask anyone for anything.” And Imam (a.s) said: “You must not give all of the zakat to your relatives, but give them some and distribute some among the rest of the Muslims.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Zakat is lawful for the owner of a house and a servant, and for one who has five hundred dirhams, provided that he has dependents. And he makes the zakat of the five hundred an increase in the maintenance of his dependents, expanding upon them.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ تُعْطِ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ أَحَداً مِمَّنْ تَعُولُ« وَ قَالَ إِذَا كَانَ لِرَجُلٍ خَمْسُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ وَ كَانَ عِيَالُهُ كَثِيراً قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاةٌ يُنْفِقُهَا عَلَى عِيَالِهِ يَزِيدُهَا فِي نَفَقَتِهِمْ وَ فِي كِسْوَتِهِمْ وَ فِي طَعَامٍ لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَطْعَمُونَهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عِيَالٌ وَ كَانَ وَحْدَهُ فَلْيَقْسِمْهَا فِي قَوْمٍ لَيْسَ بِهِمْ بَأْسٌ أَعِفَّاءَ عَنِ اَلْمَسْأَلَةِ لاَ يَسْأَلُونَ أَحَداً شَيْئاً« وَ قَالَ» لاَ تُعْطِيَنَّ قَرَابَتَكَ اَلزَّكَاةَ كُلَّهَا وَ لَكِنْ أَعْطِهِمْ بَعْضاً وَاِقْسِمْ بَعْضاً فِي سَائِرِ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ« وَ قَالَ» اَلزَّكَاةُ تَحِلُّ لِصَاحِبِ اَلدَّارِ وَ اَلْخَادِمِ وَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ خَمْسُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ عِيَالٌ وَيَجْعَلُ زَكَاةَ اَلْخَمْسِمِائَةِ زِيَادَةً فِي نَفَقَةِ عِيَالِهِ يُوَسِّعُ عَلَيْهِمْ«.
